overview: GDS completed the acquisition of BJ15 (originally BJ14) in Q2 2021. The data center is adjacent to BJ5 and 8km away from the park that consists BJ10, BJ11 and BJ12. This facility started operating in late 2018 and has an IT load of 30.7MW.

Dr Peng's Yizhuang Data Center is a 2-storey industrial building located in the Beijing Economic and Technological Development Zone with stable geographical and geological conditions. The facility went live in 2013 and has an IT load of 9.15MW.

Teledata bought the Simon House building in 2022 with plans to retrofit the building to offer 4MW capacity. Later that year, Datum Datacentres acquired Teledata UK.     Datum Datacentres instead applied to demolish the existing structure and build a new facility in June 2023, securing planning permission for this in October that year.     The MCR2 facility is located on a site adjacent to Datum's Delta House data centre.     The site went live in June 2025.

The Chesterfield County Economic Development Authority filed to rezone two properties in the county for data center use. The Watkins Centre Project property would consist of 345 acres. According to a 2025 press release, Google is the operator behind this site.

Lunar Digital acquired the Lunar 1 and 3 facility from Equinix in February 2022 which were operating their MA2 site since 2015. Prior to this, Telecity launched the Reynolds House facility in 2006 and operated it until the acquisition by Equinix. The facility spreads across 3,251 sqm.
DC Byte understands that Keppel Data Centres has pipeline plans in the EEC.

In Q4 2022, Atman announced a purchase of land in Duchnice, near Ozarow Mozowiecki. Warsaw 3 campus is scheduled to launch in Q4 2024 with first out of three data centre buildings. All buildings will have a combined 43MW of IT power. The first phase of construction began in October 2023.

Seeweb's first facility in Frosinone, the IT load of this colocation space is 200kw. This facility is one of four owned and operated by Seeweb at Frosinone, Milan and Sesto San Giovanni, with another housed at Swisscom in Lugano, Svizzera.

Vantage´s BER2 data centre campus is located in Mittenwalde a town in the Dahme-Spreewald district, in Brandenburg, Germany. The new campus was ready for services in Q4 2022 and will feature two data centres, each two-story facility when fully completed.

The QTS Cedar Rapids Data Center Campus is a planned multi-phase development located on a 612-acre site within the Big Cedar Industrial Center along 76th Avenue SW in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. Alliant Energy is the utility partner for the site. The project will span 7 buildings.  A RFS date has not been disclosed as of Q2 2025.

Hyperco is planning to build a data centre near Ockelbo, in Gävleborg County. They have purchased land near Ellevio Ställverk Grönviken. In Q2 2025, Hyperco was acquired by the Dubai-based DAMAC Group and subsumed under its DAMAC Digital data centre platform.
The Flexential Alpharetta facility, located in the Atlanta metro area, provides up to 6MW of IT load capacity and encompasses 142,000 square feet.

Located east of Austin's central business district this Alpheus center was opened in 1985 and then acquired by Logix in 2018. One of four Logix sites in Texas, this colocation facility offers <1MW with accessibility to over 70 carrier and service providers.

BJ17, BJ18, and BJ19 was developed on a data center site owned by a target company which GDS Holdings acquired in Q2 2021. BJ17 and BJ18 went live in Q3 2021, while BJ19 will become operational in 2H 2022.
The facility most likely opened in 2004 and offers less than 1 MW of IT capacity.

In 2020 Interxion acquired a 3.6 acre parcel for the development of a new data centre campus. Development is taking place in phases and the first 5MW of IT load came online in 2023. The data centre is expandable to 32MW of IT Load over a number of phases. The site is currently constructing an additional 10MW, of which 5MW is due to complete in Q2 2025, and the remaining by the end of 2025/early 2026.

Announced in Q1 2025, Edged Energy and Merlin Properties stated they would be expanding their partnership to activity in the region of Extremadura. The site is one of two gigawatt facilities planned in the region where the companies plan to construct sites focused on generative AI and advanced computing. The site in Navalmoral De La Mata sits north-east of the city of Caceres and will consist of 8-10 buildings of 100MW each. The site will use dark fibre networks from Lisbon to Madrid for communication, including one enabled by Merlin-Edged to connect its data centres in Lisbon, Getafe, Barcelona, and Arasur.
QTS began construction on their 32-acre campus in 2021. Located close to the San Antonio International Airport, the site became operational in 2023 with 90MW of critical IT capacity.

CMC Creative Space was launched at CMC Technology Corporation's 25th anniversary in 2017. Construction began in 2019 and the facility has 13,000 sqm of data center space (~1200 racks), including 2 office towers and a data centre building in between.     The first phase came live in May 2022 and more than 30% of the capacity was pre-commited.

The Atecsys data center is a large-scale carrier neutral data center park with 9 data hall buildings and 1 Internet Exchange center. The facility can house a total of 15,000 cabinets and is located in the Tianzhu Free-Trade Zone, the Shunyi Tianzhu Comprehensive Bonded Area in close proximity to Beijing Capital International Airport.     Through cooperation with the Amsterdam Internet Exchange (AMS-IX), ChinaCache's Atecsys facility hosts the CHN-IX, the first IXP to serve the Chinese market.
LF9 began operations in Q2 2021 and is located some 10km Northwest from the tight cluster of GDS LF facilities. The data center has an IT load of 21.6MW.
BDx launched the first building in their 35MW Nanjing campus in 2021. NKG 1 provides 4MW of IT Load.  The second phase of 20MW, NKG2, is currently under construction.

This facility was originally acquired by Carrier-1 in 2012 and retrofitted in 2014. After several more acquisitions this site is now part of Prime Data Centers' portfolio. This center currently offers 68,000sqft of raised floor space and 8MW of Critical IT power.
NTT's VA7 will be located on the same campus as VA3-VA6. VA7 and VA6, which is currently under construction, are expected to offer a total of 60 MW.

DFW17 is a 69 acre data center campus in North Dallas' high tech corridor. Nine different fiber providers supply telecommunications services. Electrical service to the whole park (Digital Dallas) is distributed from a dedicated privately owned substation capable of delivering up to 100 MW of power.

This data centre campus has first 3S data centres which opened in 2011 May and late 2013/early 2014. At the time they were one of the largest data centres in Poland. In May 2021, the company announced building third tier-3 level data centre on campus with an area of 2200sqm. Facility should've launched in Q1 2023, however, no updates have been announced as of yet.

The Global Cloud Data Center campus in Ponte San Pietro is located North West from Milan. The power is derived from self-produced hydroelectric and photovoltaic energy. The latest expansion involves DC-B and DC-C. The DC-B capacity is 9 MW, divided between three large rooms. The DC-C is a multi-storey data center with 4 data rooms located on two levels, and a fully operational power of 8 MW. The modules are alongside DC-A which has 10 data rooms.

This facility was retrofitted and opened in 2011 by Stream Data Centers. Stream sold the data center that same year and it is now owned and operated by Mapletree Industrial. The data center offers 20,000sqft of total space with 10,000sqft of data hall floor and is in close proximity to the DFW Telecom Corridor. The anchor tenant is Commonspirit Health.
LF10 is a build-to-suit facility built by GDS Holdings. The data center came live in Q2 2021.

Africa Data Centres CPT1 data centre is located in Cape Town. The facility is the company's first data centre for Cape Town and has been operational since 2017. A further expansion is currently under construction.

DFW35 is a 138,854sqft free-standing building in Digital Realty's 69 acre campus known as Digital Dallas. The project is located in North Dallas' high technology corridor, with a privately owned substation capable of delivering up to 100 MW of power. Telecommunications services are provided by nine different fiber providers currently located on the campus.

Khazna began construction of its second data centre in Masdar, Abu Dhabi in April 2022 and was set completed by Q1 2024. The facility will be partially powered by the solar plant developed by Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar and EDF.
The Langfang Gu'An Data Center campus began construction in 2020 and upon completion, will house 25,000 racks within 10 data centre buildings.
LF5 is located beside GDS Holdings' LF3 and LF3 facilities. Phase 1 went live in Q2 2022 and phase 2 is only planned to be operational 2024 and beyond.

1547 Critical Systems Realty and Harrison Street purchased the Chase Tower carrier hotel and office building in December 2022. The building was constructed in 1980 for McAllen State Bank. The building has connections to 46 different networks and serves an internet gateway between Mexico and the United States.

In June 2023, Lunar Digital announced the launch of their Lunar 3 data centre East of Manchester. The data centre spreads across a total of 836 square metres and offers 500 square metre of white space to its customers.

SAMX applied to rezone a 55.26 acre parcel in Fauquier County, Virginia in late 2023. If approved, the campus would house multiple data center buildings with around 1 million square feet of infrastructure.
The DBX2 data centre is one of two facilities announced by Khazna in October 2022. Located in the Dubai Design District, it went operational in 2024.
Announced December 2020, du's facility in Kizad Khalifa Industrial Zone is in development following the sale of their stake in Khazna. It opened in September 2021.

NTT´s Johannesburg 1 data centre is located in Johannesburg, South Africa. The facility is the NTT`s first data centre in Johannesburg and went live with its first phase in October 2022 and the second phase in Q4 2024.
EC51 is Edge Centres first data center in Vietnam announced in May 2022, in collaboration with the Vietnam National University. The facility opened in December 2022.

STACK Infrastructure's STO01B facility will come online in Q3 2028 with 18MW capacity. They have reserved 24MVA input power and are currently constructing an on-site substation to deliver this. The facility will target wholesale tenants.
In 2003, the Englewood data center began operations. The facility was sold to Databank in 2021 becoming their DEN1 facility. It offers up to 2MW of IT load over 19,390sqft of white space.
This facility opened in August 2023 and replaced InterConnect's 's-Hertogenbosch facility located 600 metres away.

The Liguaria Digitale data center was initiated in 2005 with goals to enhance the digital strategy of the businesses and public administration of the Liguaria region. Located at the WTC, the data center completed it's renovation in 2022. The facility now hosts 4000 servers within 2000 sqm.

CloudHQ's DC-6 data centre in Manassas, Virginia began construction in 2008 under Power Loft. Power Loft completed the shell at the beginning of 2010 before the company and data centre were acquired by COPT months later. COPT finished construction on the facility soon thereafter, and CloudHQ acquired DC-6 in early 2022. The 21,646 square metre facility offers 9,290 sqm of data hall floor and 19.25 MW of IT load.

This project is filed by Project West WHP - GA LLC to be located in LaGrange, GA on a plot of 513 acres.  It will be a campus with six 252,000 sqft buildings. Phase 1 is set to finish in 2028, Phase 2 in 2030, and Phase 3 in 2033.

In October, Viettel unveiled plans to construct 24 data centres with a total capacity of 560MW, along with four new undersea fibre optic cable routes. These initiatives are reportedly part of Viettel's long-term plan to meet 60% of the country’s international connectivity demand by 2030.     The exact development timelines are currently undisclosed.

Hoa Lac Data Center located in Hanoi, Vietnam is Viettel second data centre in Hanoi and has been operational since 2014 offering a 17,500sqm building size. The data centre has been build to expand the technical space capacity for the city Hanoi.
This facility is a 40,000 sq ft development in Kearney, Nebraska sitting on 16 acres within the TechoNE Crossing technology park.  This site is currently in the early stage as of Q3 2025.

Apatura has submitted an application notice for an AI data centre campus in Hermiston, west of Edinburgh. It is going currently through initial pre-application consultation stages.     The proposed development involves an AI data centre campus with input power 200MVA.
The facility is located in Huailai County of Zhangjiakou, Hebei Province.        (Coordinates to be confirmed)

Through Duos Technologies' subsidiaries: Duos Edge AI and Duos Energy, the company plans to develop four 50MW data centers in Pampa, Texas at the Pampa Energy Center.     The first 50MW center is expected to be live by Q4 2025 and the 500 acre site is to be supported by a combination of self-generated natural gas, wind turbine generation, along with some alternative fuel services.     This site marks Duos' second data center project in Texas following their Edge data center in Amarillo, TX that was announced in Q3 2024.

This facility is part of the Equinix GIC joint venture where GIC receives 80% stake for a certain investment amount whilst Equinix receives 20% and transfers TY12x and OS2x to the partnership. Phase 1 of OS2x launched in Q4 2021 offering 9MW of IT Load. Phase 2 was completed in Q4 2022 to bring total IT Load to 14MW.

Equinix's SV3 data center in San Jose, California, was opened in 2002. Equinix purchased the site from AboveNet Communications in 2004 for $900,000. In Q2 2023, Invesco Real Estate is the new landlord of the data center. The previous landlord owners, Sobrato Organization, sold the site for $83.6 million.
Across a 1.7 ha plot, GTD's data centre Lidice 2. It is the second data centre opened in Lidice. It is one of the two data centre in Lidice's complex. It opened in 2016 with 1 MW of IT load.

In Q3 2024, FinCap DC Corp Oy bought 99,000 sqm of land at an industrial park in Lahti for data centre development at the properties Ilmarisentie 3 and Väinämöisentie 2 A + B from Spatium Toimitilat. In Q3 2025, it was revealed that DayOne will operate a data centre campus on this plot, with 128MW IT load planned. They have not yet submitted any planning permission but aim to begin demolition works in Q3 2025, with delivery planned in 2027.
CapitaLand announced their entry into the Japanese data centre market in February 2025 for a facility in Osaka.     Exact location is unconfirmed, but speculated to be this site in Ibaraki.

Formerly known as DigiPlex´s Oslo - Hobøl data centre is located in Tomter in Norway. The facility has been in operation since October 2020. The facility was partly financed though fully subscribed NOK 655million bond issue which were to get listed in Oslo stock exchange in the same autumn. In Q1 2022 were announced that DigiPlex is now part of Stack Infrastructure. Facility name were changed to OSL04 Campus. First building is now called OSL04B with further OSL04C in design phase.
Across a 2.2 ha plot, Netglobalis' Phillips Data Center is located in Santiago. It opened in 2005 in Santiago. It opened with 0.5 MW of IT load in a 1350 sqm building.
H5 acquired its data center in Herndon, Virginia in June 2025. H5 plans to develop 15 critical megawatts in the 53,000 square foot building with an expected RFS data of Q1 2027.

HMC Capital has submitted plans to develop a large-scale data center in Monterey Park, Los Angeles County, California. The project, located at 1977 Saturn Street, will involve demolishing existing vacant commercial structures to construct a 218,400-square-foot, single-story facility with an on-site electrical substation. The proposed data center will feature 14 backup diesel generators, each with a capacity of 4MW, pointing to a potential power capacity of 56MW. The development represents a significant investment in the area’s digital infrastructure and is aligned with HMC’s broader expansion into U.S. data center assets.
Aarhus data centre estimated to have opened around 2010. Fuzion bought by Kolo Data Centers on September 2023.

The first data center of Prime's Sacramento campus went live in 2021. The facility is located in McClellan Park and is seismically stable and above the 500-year floodplain. The 15-hectare plot has room for up to six data centers which will be built in three phases.

Equinix's SV4 data centre in Sunnyvale, California was built in 2006. The 10,000sqm facility's proximity to Silicon Valley allows it access to the two largest peering hubs in the area. The facility is also connected to carriers both domestic and international.

This purpose-build data center will focus almost exclusively on AI and hyperscale leases. Partnering with Nadia Partners, Beacon is primed to construct over 2GW of power across multiple projects. This facility will mirror its five anticipated sister sites in capacity.

Announced in late 2024, Calvano Development is aiming for a single-story data center to be utilized by a hyperscale tenant once it is built out. It will be located next to an Oncor facility as well as a transmission and distribution electric utility. At full-build the project could reach 2.3 million sqft and up to 300MW of power built out in phases.     Land rezoning was approved for the site in November 2024, but further info regarding development and exact address remain to be shared.

In Q4 2024, Hyperco agreed to buy 130 hectares of land from the Municipality of Pyhäjoki - Hyperco's largest land transaction to date. They will have 300,000 sqm building rights for the plot.     Zoning efforts are ongoing, with an ambition to complete zoning procedures by the end of 2025.     In Q2 2025, Hyperco was acquired by the Dubai-based DAMAC Group and subsumed under its DAMAC Digital data centre platform.
EMC HostCo´s MUC I data centre is located in Munich in Germany and has been in operation since 2007.
NorthC's Münchenstein (Basel) 2 serves as a backup to Münchenstein (Basel) 1, being located just a few hundred metres away.

Data Foundry's Houston 1 data center is located inside the Marathon Oil Tower near Downtown Houston, Texas. Data Foundry entered the building as Texas.net, which was founded in 1994. In 2002, Texas.net acquired an adjacent data center suite owner by Reliant energy, more than doubling its space in the building. In 2005, Texas.net rebranded as Data Foundry. In 2021, Switch Data Centers acquired Data Foundry as well as its data center portfolio. Data Foundry still operates the facilities.
Just south of the Phoenix Goodyear Airport, Vantage has begun development on their AZ2 site in Goodyear, AZ. Once fully built they expect to offer 48MW of critical IT capacity.

In January 2023, Crane Data Centers announced that they would be developing a large facility West of Hillsboro in Forest Grove. The data center will be delivered in two phases and is expected to spread across 300,000 square feet in phase 1 and deliver 50 MW. Groundbreaking was delayed, but occured in Q2 2025.

Cielo Digital Infrastructure is planning a four building campus in Gaffney, on the state border with NC. Each building will be 400,000 sqft and be located on an 86 acre plot. The campus is expected to total 300MW at full buildout with initial operations to go online by the end of 2028.
CPH3 is Digital Realty's third data centre in Denmark, located on the same campus as its other two facilities. The facility was launched in the first half on 2022 and has 6,968 sqm floor space.
Gotspace Data Partners Campus Griswold Site 2 is a planned large-scale data center development located in Griswold, CT 06351. Gotspace is planning a seven-building campus.
In 2018, a company called Hiddenwood Lane LLC acquired a parcel of land in Aldie, Virginia. Planning documents refer to the site as JK Technology Park #2, associated with JK Land Holdings.

CoreSite's LA2 data center was acquired in 2006. It is 39,473 square meters, connected to LA1 through dark fiber, and sits adjacent to the new LA3 facility. LA2 offers connections to several cloud service providers.

Aligned Energy's data center in Dallas, Texas sits on a 18.5-acre plot. The center was retrofitted in 2015 and was expanded in 2019. In late 2022, Aligned began the construction of an additional data center - DFW02 - on the same plot.

Equinix's SV11 data center was opened in 2020. The 12,400 sqm building's Silicon Valley location allows for access to one of the world’s largest internet exchanges and peering points as well as both domestic and international. At full build, the facility will offer 20 megawatts of power.

This purpose-build data center will focus almost exclusively on AI and hyperscale leases. Partnering with Nadia Partners, Beacon is primed to construct over 2GW of power across multiple projects. This facility will mirror its five anticipated sister sites in capacity.
In February 2025, WorldLink Communications launched a 3.5MW data centre in Chandragiri. The facility is located close to the Mata Tirtha substation.
Together with Greek energy provider IPTO, Serverfarm plans to develop a 130 MW data centre campus in Kryoneri, north of Athens.

Equinix's SV8 facility in Palo Alto, California was built in 2004. The 4,210sqm building offers interconnections to one of the world’s largest internet exchanges and peering points, a mix of global networks and cloud services providers, and international carrier connections.

In Q3 2022, Euskaltel partnered with Teknei Group, Dominion and the Basque Government to build a data centre. The facility will offer retail colocation services to companies and institutions requiring a large storage capacity for cloud services. Their first location will be located in The Ezkerraldea Technological Park. Phase 1 of 1MW is due to go live in March 2025. A second phase of an additional 1MW will follow with the potential of further deployments depending on the site's demand. The exact location within the Technological park is yet to be determined.

April 2024, Viettel announced the launch of the Viettel Hoa Lac Data Centre. The facility has a floor area of ​​more than 21,000 sqm and certified with ANSI/TIA-942-B:2017 Rated-3 Constructed Facilities, and level 4 (Rated-4) in the Telecommunications category.
In 2025, PointOne acquired a site in Sterling, Virginia for data center use. The company is planning 244,000 square feet of infrastructure.
Tecto Sao Paulo 1 located in Santana de Paranaiba, is the first Tecto data centre located in Sao Paulo. Furthermore, It is projected to have 200 MW at the end of the project.

Located just South of Global Switch's London North data centre. After going through the planning application process, the Tower Hamlets Council initially refused the plans. The real estate developers went on to appeal the decision and won in October 2023.      The site itself will host a blend of residential, office space and data centre developments and could ultimately appeal to one of the local operators.

In August 2022, Dreammark1 announced that they had signed for 0.4ha land for a 7,279sqm building in Incheon to build a data centre. It is located in the Ju-an National Industrial Complex.     The facility was completed in December 2023.

US real estate firm Tishman Speyer and Mainova WebHouse, a subsidiary of the Frankfurt energy firm Mainova planning to build in a joint venture a data centre in the Ostend area of Frankfurt. Timelines for development weren't shared.
Announced in Q2 2024, Khazna partnered with the Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) to build a data centre in the Mafraq industrial area.     The facility is planned to be ready mid-2026.

Following the merger of POST Luxembourg's EBRC subsidiary with 3 other subsidiaries, this facility is now operated under the name DEEP.      The RCE Kayl is one of three operated by DEEP in Luxembourg and provides 9.6MW of IT capacity across 5000 sqm.
Operational since 2011, the Baltnet facility is located south of Vilnius, close to the Vilnius airport. It is separated into two data halls.

CoreSite's LA1 data center in Los Angeles is located inside the massive carrier hotel, One Wilshire. One Wilshire is one of the most connected data centers in the world and is connected via subsea cables to the Asia-Pacific area. LA1 is connected via dark fiber to CoreSite's LA2.
In January 2025, Doma Infrastructure Group (DIG) announced plans to develop a 50-60MW AI-ready data centre in Western Sydney.
NTT is in the process of entering the Milan market. They acquired a 21 ha plot of land on which they will build a 128 MW campus.
nLighten's Garching data centre went live in 2023, after the company launched in Germany.

This facility is considered one of the most connected data centers in the DFW area. Digital Realty occupies the entire second floor, providing around 34,983sqft of colocation space. The facility was initially owned by Telx starting in 2007 and was expanded in 2010. Equinix acquired the data center in late 2015.

DC J13 facility is said to be largest data exchange hub in Lithuania. It houses 5 separate data centre facilities on premises. By the end of 2021, the company modernised this facility UPS systems and will further invest in modernisation of cooling equipment.

Equinix´s MA3 data centre a former Telecity facility as Joule House is located in Manchester in the United Kingdom. The data centre has been in operation since 2012 and has a total building area of 4,181 sqm.

Markley’s One Summer street location is New England’s primary telecommunications facility and only “Carrier Hotel”. Home to over 100 different carriers and network providers.     Facility is one of the largest and oldest telco and data centre buildings in the New England. More than 250 companies have their servers placed within this facility, including NTT, British Telecom, Harvard, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and the Boston Internet Exchange. Data centre spans across 1million sq ft.     Markley purchased this facility in 1997 and converted the building to telecommunications and data centre facility within next 2 years. The first tenants were telecommunications companies seeking a facility where they could all interconnect their networks. From 2004, Markley began leasing the facility to corporate clients.

In March 2021, EdgeConnex announced the construction of its first data centre in Barcelona, Spain. The facility went live in Q1 2022 with its first phase of 3.4MW and completed an additional expansion which was finalised in late 2023/early 2024.

Mapletree's data center in San Jose, California was retrofitted in 2005. It is a 7,098 square meter facility that offers 2,175 sqm of data hall floor and 1.5 MW of power. The building has been upgraded to exceed earthquake-resistant standards and is located just five miles from the San Jose Mineta International Airport. Evoque owned the facility from its opening to late 2022, at which point the site was acquired by Mapletree Industrial but the facility is still operated by Evoque.
Established in 2000 by Layer One, this facility was then purchased by Switch and Data in 2005, and then again by Equinix in 2010. The data center has expanded twice.

The Gouldsboro Data Center is a proposed 35-building, 1.5 GW campus in Northeast Pennsylvania by 1778 Rich Pike LLC, an entity affiliated with NE Edge. Planned across 1,000 acres in Clifton and Covington Townships (Lackawanna County), each building could span up to 379,500 square feet over three floors, with the entire campus offering between 4.4 and 9.4 million square feet of space.

Initially opened by Onyx in 2012 and acquired by Pulsant in 2016. The facility will support 360kW of IT load once fully developed.     In July 2021, Antin Infrastructure Partners acquired Pulsant from Oak Hill Capital and Scottish Equity Partners.
This project was filed by East Village Dothan LLC. which will rezone 700 acres of land for data center use. It will have 11 building totaling 6.2 million sqft as well as four warehouses.

In September 2025, Tract filed to rezone 430 acres to construct a data center campus. The proposed campus is located in Hanover County and is the company's second proposed campus in the greater Richmond area.

Internet Doorway Inc., or NETDOOR as its known to its clients, was set up in 1995 by a  small group of investors providing internet connectivity in Mississippi. Six-years later, they opened their first data centre, providing colocation and web hosting services to businesses in the Jackson areas and beyond, and are still leading provider in Mississippi.

A hyperscale data center is planned on a 220-acre parcel at the northern edge of Van Wert’s Mega Site.  The project is being developed by an unnamed entity, and the future operator has not been disclosed.   A firm power agreement has been secured with AEP Ohio to deliver 500 MW via 345 kV transmission lines. As of July 2025, the land transaction had not yet been finalized.
LEW's first data centre was constructed in 2004, offering retail colocation services to predominantly local customers.

In 2020, Nabiax announced the construction of the second data centre within its Alcala Campus. Development is taking place in phases, with the first phase having been launched in Q1 2022 - and the site being scalable to accommodate another load of this size. Nabiax announced another expansion to the site in Q3 2023 which saw an increase of 47% to the campus' installed capacity. This expansion completed in mid-2024.

In August 2025, Open DC announced the official launch of PE2. Located on a ten-acre campus in the Bayan Lepas Technology Park, PE2 has an initial capacity of 10 MW, scalable to 30 MW.  The facility hosts DE-CIX Malaysia’s Penang Internet Exchange transport node, enabling local internet traffic exchange. This reduces latency and improves connectivity for telecommunications providers, and supports sectors including technology, manufacturing, and finance.

Echelon's DUB 20 data centre campus in Arklow, Co. Wicklow, spans 100 acres and is set to become one of Ireland’s most sustainable data centre projects.     Designed with an initial capacity of 90 MW, expandable to 204MW, DUB20 is notable for being the first data centre in Ireland to meet the Commission for Regulation of Utilities (CRU) requirements for a grid connection under the new guidelines.     Positioned near the Arklow Wind Park, DUB20 will leverage proximity to this renewable energy source, incorporating a 220kV substation and options for direct green power agreements.     Echelon announced the start of construction at DUB 20 in Q3 2025, having secured a grid connection in 2024 and being officially launched by the Taoiseach in May 2025.

Brennercom founded in 1998 was a managed service provider and joined the Retelit Group in January 2020. Retelit is now currently fully owned by Marbles S.p.a, the holding company of Asterion, which also owns majority stake in Irideos. Irideos’ shareholder Marguerite’s stake were acquired by Asterion, with Marguerite having reinvested them into Marbles S.p.a. As of Q4 2022, the Retelit and Irideos are expected to merge.
PointOne is planning a 250-acre, 600MW data center campus in Charles City County, VA. The campus would offer 3.25 million square feet of infrastructure across seven buildings.

First announced in September 2022, Kio Networks first began construction on their second data centre in Spain, a facility then described as the largest data centre in the Valencian Community. It was announced that the site began construction in Q1 2023 and is set to open in 2025. The site came under the ownership of El Corte Ingles when the company acquired KIO's Spanish portfolio.
Daycohost's data centre opened in 2001. It was the first data centre opened by Daycohost in Venezuela. It is a small data centre located in Caracas, Venezuela's capital.

In Q2 2025, CyrusOne topped out its Wood Dale data center campus, marking the completion of vertical construction for both planned buildings. The site will ultimately deliver approximately 18 MW of capacity across 500,000 square feet.

A cosmopolitan city known for its assimilative cultural ethos, Hyderabad, the state capital of Telangana has the presence of four out of the world's five most valued tech companies. The information and communication technology (ICT) industry has transformed the image of Hyderabad from a manufacturing and research hub to that of a global services destination. In a location least prone to natural calamities, the city has emerged as a favourable destination for disaster recovery where STT Hyderabad DC1 is a Rated-3 facility within the heart of hi-tech city.

MY02 was acquired and renamed by Bridge Data Centers in 2018 from CFS Group- CX2 and CX5. The facility comprises three blocks of five-storey buildings with a planned total gross floor space of 53,883 sqm with 18,580 sqm of data center space.

Brennercom founded in 1998 was a managed service provider and joined the Retelit Group in January 2020. Retelit is now currently fully owned by Marbles S.p.a, the holding company of Asterion, which also owns majority stake in Irideos. Irideos’ shareholder Marguerite’s stake were acquired by Asterion, with Marguerite having reinvested them into Marbles S.p.a.  Retelit and Irideos are expected to merge in order to consolidate their positions in the telecom sector.

SK Broadband constructed a data centre in Yangju which began construction in Q3 2023 for completion in Q4 2024, which was delayed to Q1 2025.     The data centre spans approximately 12,300sqm of building area.

Logistic Land Investments LLC filed for an 18 building hyperscale campus off of Rock Mountain Road in Bessemer, Alabama which got approval in June 2025. This project will feature 18 buildings, 250,000 sqft each, and will be developed on a 700 acre plot, totaling to around 1.2GW of power. The project is estimated to be complete by 2032.

CyrusOne's Amsterdam 1 and 2 facility offers tailored, secure, resilient hosting solutions to managed services and system integrators, cloud providers, and international corporations. The facility will deliver 54MW of IT load at total fit out within 29,720 sqm (320,000 sq ft) of technical space. The 2nd phase has now begun construction.

Vint Hill Corners LLC applied to rezone 46.2 acres in Fauquier County. If approved, the campus would house two data center buildings with 330,000 square feet and 390,000 square feet of infrastructure respectively.

This facility was opened by GramTel in the early 2000's, and then acquired by Cincinatti Bell in July 2008 . In June 2010, Cincinatti Bell acquired CyrusOne, then spun if off in 2015.  The facility was then inherited by CyrusOne which continued to operate. In 2019, it was put up for sale. The data hall size is 550 sqm.

In Q2 2024 Vantage announced they would be developing a $185 million facility on the Lincoln Rackhouse "Silicon Heartland" site. The plans followed Vantage's announcement that the company raised $9.2 billion in equity led by DigitalBridge Group Inc. and Silver Lake.

The name Pionen is derived from Cold War code name. Formerly it was a civil defense center and nuclear bunker in White Mountains, below the Vita Bergen park in Södermalm in Stockholm. Located 30 meters underground, the facility is said to be capable to withstand a hydrogen bomb explosion. In 2007-2008, 4000 cubic metres of solid rock was blasted away to create space for a data centre which became operational in September 2008. Facility is also known for its lighting design ideas borrowed from James Bond movies and 'Silent Running'. Others may recognise this data centre as the facility which held WikiLeaks servers.  Currently the data centre accommodates company's network operations, offers cloud and colocation services.

Opened in 2007 under Interxion, PAR4 forms part of the Digital Realty Paris network of data centres which is spread over three zones in the city. The site is situated in the north-west of the city, within the neighbourhood of Nanterre.
The Dutch data centre operator acquired a 5 ha parcel of land in the vicinity of Warsaw. They plan to build a 60 MW facility initially, with over 100+ MW possible expansion in the future.

Nunsys' data centre is located next to the company headquarters in Valencia. In Q2 2024, Nunsys announced their intention to expand the site, bringing the facility's total scale to 3.5MW across 1,200sqm of data hall space upon completion.
In July 2025, Macquarie Data Centres announced a put and call option for a plot of land in Macquarie Park for a planned 150MW campus.

The Slidell EdgeConneX Edge Data Center® (EDC) has been purpose-built and precisely located in order to provide a secure colocation facility for customers wishing to deliver content and applications to local-market consumers in and around New Orleans, with the lowest possible latency. Partnering with network and cable operators at the local level, our carrier neutral facility guarantees the shortest and fastest routes  for delivering content to local market subscribers (consumer and enterprise) and Internet customers.
NTT Jakarta 3 Data Centre is a four-story facility with 18,000 sqm data hall size across 3 buildings. The facility is expected to reach 45 MW when it is fully developed.

In 2021, DCX purchased this site from Collier's International. In late 2022, DCX opened a data center in Goodyear, AZ as a self-build AI facility. They intend to expand the first building and add an additional facility in phases.

This 1.8GW campus is a joint venture between AI-focused operator Crusoe and energy infrastructure provider Tallgrass. Scaleable up to 10GW of power, the campus will be powered by renewable energy and natural gas. It will consist of five 805,000sqft buildings and have its own onsite power plant.     Construction is estimated to begin in Q4 2025 and end in Q4 2028.

Thule data centre has been designed by the same architects as the Pionen facility. This data centre has also attracted the media's attention for its selection of lighting resembling a disco hall due to dry ice and neon light hoops.  The facility is the largest in Bahnhof's portfolio, until Elementica goes live. Data centre houses 240 racks.

Oct 2023, Edgnex by Damac Group, UAE real estate firm revealed its plans for a data centre facility in Cyberjaya, Malaysia. Damac has proposed a scale of 1.21 hectares. The project is in the early stage and the exact location is currently undisclosed.  The investment is valued at RM250 million (approximately $52.4 million USD).

The data centre offers services since 2014. Facility has 175 sqm of floor space. Since 2020, data centre has 189 solar panels fitted on three of the sidewalls. In 2020, Penta Infra invested in DataCenter Fryslân and became its shareholder.

Nostrum Evergreen is a 300MW data centre development located near Badajoz in Extremadura, southern Spain.     Set to begin construction in 2026, the project will be built in phases with a total investment of €1.9 billion ($2.2 billion). The first phase will include data halls and critical infrastructure with an initial capacity of 150MW of electrical power. The second phase will begin in 2029 and will expand the site to 300MW of electrical power. Full design could scale up to 500MW of electrical power. The data centre will be designed to support high-density workloads.     Permitting is expected by mid-2026. Operations are expected to commence in 2027. Nostrum Evergreen in Badajoz is part of a broader pipeline of over 700MW of data centre projects across Spain.

In November 2023, QTS announced the acquisition of this land and it's plan to develop a two-building data center campus. The buildings on this campus are planned to total approximately 82,275 square meters.

Expedient operates the Blue Cross Data Center from Blue Cross Shield. However, Five 9s Digital own the land. The data center serves up to 3.6MW of IT Load. The site was acquired in the end of 2021 for $11million.
Rackspace's NYC2 data center is one of two facilities in Somerset, New Jersey. The data center was opened in 2008 as a DataPipe facility and offers 34,993 sq ft of data hall floor.

Cyberjaya 4 Annex is an extension project for NTT Cyberjaya 4 data center, otherwise known as 'Sora Block'. It was opened in 2017 together with 'Sora' office building to facilitate growing customer needs. With the launch of Cyberjaya 4 Annex, NTT was awarded 'Rate 4 - Data Center Operations Standard' issued by EPI.
The facility most likely went live in 2015 and offers less than 1 MW of IT capacity.

JK5 went live in Q2 2021 and is DCI's fourth data center building located on the MM2100 Industrial Town campus. The facility has a capacity of 15 MW and received the Data Center Service & Maintenance Team and Hyperscale Innovation Power & Cooling awards at W.Media Cloud and Data Center Awards in Q4 2021.
This facility by CloudHQ aims to provide 84MW of IT capacity. The development is still to obtain permits before construction can begin.
December 2024, Edgenex by DAMAC acquired land totaling 800,400 sq ft (74,360 sqm) from Malaysian property development firm Crescendo Corporation subsidiary Paranoramic Industrial Development.

QTS's data center in Jersey City was opened in 2006. QTS operates its 119,996 sq ft facility out of 95 Christopher Columbus Drive, conveniently located near the World Trade Center and the Holland Tunnel. The 31,495 sq ft data hall offers 3 megawatts of IT load.

This data centre in Northern Murcia opened in 2014 under Kio Networks. In August 2021, I Squared Capital announced the acquisition of KIO through its ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund III and ISQ Growth Markets Infrastructure Fund. The site then came under the ownership of El Corte Ingles when the company acquired full ownership of KIO's Spanish portfolio. In Q4 2025, it was announced that El Corte Inglés had developed a new subsidiary, Kumo Networks, to manage its data centres.
VAN6 is Cologix's newest project. Located immediately next to VAN5, VAN6 will act similarly to an expansion and provide customers with the same connectivity to Cologix's Vancouver fiber ring.
This facility is Equinix's fifth Sydney facility. It is located in Alexandria. The facility was first ready for service in late 2019, with an initial capacity involving 1825 cabinets.
Compass DataCenters announced this $10 billion data center campus in Meridian, Mississippi. This will be a 500 MW campus with eight buildings constructed over an eight year period.
DC 1 (PJ) is located within Section 13 of Petaling Jaya and has an area of 8175 sqm.
NorthC's Hamburg data centre was acquired from Lumen Technologies in 2025. The two-storey facility has been in operation since 2000 and provides a total building area of 8,394 sqm.

Atlas Agro, a Switzerland-based fertilizer company, intends to build five 500,000sqft facilities across 275 acres of land. The campus will be located in the Northwest Advanced Clean Energy Park and will support online operations for a myriad of industries. Atlas Agro plans to start construction by 2027, but the city has a repurchase right if the company does not submit for planning permission in eight months or begin construction within 18 months. The anticipated power supply is not yet known.

Originally submitted to the Mesa Planning Department in Q4 2023, Pacific Proving  LLC wanted to develop a 173 acre data center campus located to the east of Legacy Park in Mesa, Arizona.     In Q1 2025 it was announced that NTT acquired the site for $300 million.     The original plan for the campus was to have 6 data centers with 1.4million sqft of white space across 32 data halls. With a plan to offer 360MW of critical IT at full build out.     NTT has since shared they plan for 7 buildings totaling 324 MW of capacity, with the first building being operational in November 2028. News regarding construction timeline have not been shared as of yet.

This purpose-build data center will focus almost exclusively on AI and hyperscale leases. Partnering with Nadia Partners, Beacon is primed to construct over 2GW of power across multiple projects. This facility will mirror its five anticipated sister sites in capacity.

Digital Realty's Cloud House is located next to Cloud House West (fka Bonnington House). The facility was launched in 2020 and supports 3MW of IT load across 2,600 sqm of data hall, with potential for 1MW of expansion.     In June 2024, it was announced that CBRE had acquired the freehold of the facility from Abrdn for £48.65 million. Digital Realty will continue to operate the data centre until 2048 paying £2.86 million of annual rent.
LF16 is the second building in the Xianghe campus. It is planned to be developed in three phases, with the first phase set to be ready for service in 2024.

Cloud HQ and the site operator Infraserv Hoechst concluded a corresponding agreement for 13 hectares for its second data centre campus in Frankfurt. The new campus will be in Hoechst Industrial Park in Frankfurt.

Aligned Data Centers opened their PHX-01 data center in 2017 and expanded in 2018. Having added two buildings since to the property (PHX-02 and PHX-03), they announced their expansion to add PHX-05 (the fourth and final building for this campus) in March 2022. At full build-out this campus expects to provide 180MW of capacity.

At the start of 2019, eStruxture announced its plans for a new data centre in Burnaby, British Columbia. The full building has 55,000 sqft of total space with 13 MW of gross power, and is currently in the final stages of construction. The facility offers 10 MW of IT load and 25,000sqft of white space across two data halls. VAN-3 is connected by a dedicated fibre ring to VAN-1 and VAN-2.

GreenSquareDC acquired this old IBM site for their first project in Sydney. The land deal is expected to be finalised at the end of 2024. In March 2025, GreenSquareDC secured a A$1.2 billion investment from Partners Group.
This data center campus will be located in Rome, Georgia and on a 231 acre plot. Further details unknown.

Oakland University is developing a colocation edge data center through a public-private partnership on a five-acre parcel at its Rochester, Michigan campus. The site is located next to an existing DTE Energy substation with up to 26 MW of available utility capacity. In June 2025, the university issued an RFP seeking a private partner to design, build, finance, operate, and maintain the facility, with Brailsford & Dunlavey advising on the project. The data center will follow a retail colocation model serving multiple tenants. Oakland University plans to occupy no more than 1 MW of capacity, housed within a dedicated 2,000 sq ft high-performance computing data hall and a 1,000 sq ft office for AI workloads. The remaining capacity will be leased to third-party users. As of Q3 2025, 32 firms had expressed interest in the project, and partner selection is expected in August. No RFS date has been announced.

In January 2022, Equinix and Singapore's sovereign wealth fund GIC announced a JV to construct 2 hyperscale facilities SL2x and SL3x in Seoul of 24MW each. SL2x is slated for a Q4 2023 completion date to enter service in Q1 2024.     Equinix are also reselling 475 racks from SL2x for SL4.
STACKIT's DC 01 launched in 2018, and is located close to the company's headquarters in Neckarsulm.

GDS Holdings acquired BJ10, BJ11 and BJ12 in Q2 2020. The 3 data centers are directly adjacent to one another and are located in Shunyi district. BJ12 went live in the same quarter that acquisition was completed and has an IT load of 13.3MW.
With approval obtained in May 2021 as a State Significant Development, Stockland Trust Management Ltd 's application highlighted the project to include 6300 sqm of colocation space.

DCI Data Centers has a project in Gasan, Seoul. The data centre is scheduled for completion in mid-2025.     DL E&C will be in charge of the construction of the data centre spanning 8 storeys with 1 basement level.

Located in Slough, LD11x spreads across 6,366 sqm of data hall. The facility is part of Equinix's Slough Campus including LD4, LD5, LD6, LD7, LD10 and LD13x data centres. The facility is the second xScale data centre in the UK, the project is a joint venture between Equinix and the Singaporean sovereign wealth fund GIC.     LD4, LD5, LD6, LD7 and LD10 create a unique network ecosystem in West London and has been a significant factor in the popularity of the estate due to the network infrastructure they have attracted.
Actis have a project in Ansan for over 60MW of planned IT Load.      Hyundai E&C will be responsible for the construction of the project.

January 2025, Stack Infrastructure announced its expansion into Malaysia with plans for a 216MW campus in Johor. The 10.8 hectare campus is designed with 2 buildings. The first phase is 120MW with 2 story and scheduled for delivery in Q4 2026.

In Aug 2020, Equinix acquired GPX India for a cash value of  US$161 million. GPX Mumbai 1 otherwise known as GPX India Private received an Uptime Institute. The transition began last year in Q3 2020 and in Q3 2021, was announced as complete.

In November 2024, VCI Global announced it had secured USD 30 million in investment for its AI data centre project in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The funding, from Alumni Capital, is in addition to an earlier USD 5 million investment from the same source. Both investments are intended to support the construction of the facility, which is planned to host 512 Nvidia H200 Tensor Core GPUs.  The project’s first phase was originally scheduled to launch in Q1 2025.     VCI Global, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, operates across five business segments: fintech, consultancy, real estate, AI & robotics, and cybersecurity. Its AI division provides GPU servers, cloud computing services, and large language model solutions to clients in the Asia-Pacific region, the United States, Europe, and the Middle East.
H5's data center in Phoenix, Arizona was acquired from NextFort in 2015. Beginning with one building they have since expanded to three buildings (A, B and C) on this site with room for expansion.

atNorth's facility in Stockholm Data Parks is a two storey, extremely power efficient building that will have 7 built autonomous modules. Facility will be capable to support 12MW of power capacity. Facility is ready for HPC hosting. In Q4 2022, Proptivity announced partnership with atNorth. Proptivity servers will be hosted in its data centre in Kista.

BJ13 was built through a JV between GDS Holdings and CITIC Private Equity Funds Management (CPE Fund). The facility is 21,000sqm and is located in Yizhuang, Tongzhou District. Phase 1 will go live in Q4 2022 and phase 2 will come online in the second half of 2023.

This purpose-build data center will focus almost exclusively on AI and hyperscale leases. Partnering with Nadia Partners, Beacon is primed to construct over 2GW of power across multiple projects. This facility will mirror its five anticipated sister sites in capacity.

CyrusOne's 11,956sqm Sterling IV facility sits on a 4-hectare plot with 7,522 sqm of data hall floor and 1.6MW of critical power. The first 6 MW phase went live in 2016 and the second phase added 6.6 MW in the latter half of 2017.
Wingu´s Dar es Salaam Data Center is located in Dar es Salaam in Tanzania. The Tier 3 facility is the company's first data center in Tanzania, which went live in 2022.

Flexential constructed this facility when they were still trading as Peak10 and opened it in 2016 with an initial 2 MW of IT capacity. A 2019 expansion brought the total raised floor space to around 4830 sqm with a total capacity of 6 MW. Another expansion to the facility of 1190 sqm was announced in July 2021 putting the facility at a total of 8 MW.
The BJ2 facility opened in 2017 and forms a cluster with BJ1, BJ3 and BJ9 in the vicinity.

This campus was filed by Western Hospitality Partners, further details on the company unknown. It was located on a 267 acre plot and was originally planned to have eight buildings that totaled 2.5 million sqft.     In Q2 2025, this project was downsized due to public opposition. It will now be located 5 miles south of its original location and have two buildings instead.

ICE's Basildon data centre was acquired from NYSE in 2013 having initially opened in May 2010 as the NYSE Life data center. As it typical of financial data centres of the time, the data centre is extremely highly specified by modern data centre standards, with particular emphasis on security and resilience.     The property is located on a 6.5 hectare site and has a building footprint of approximately 30,000 square metres.
PAIX Data Centres enters a joint venture with the Djibouti Sovereign Fund and plans to build a data center in Djibouti. The JIB1 facility is expected to go live in 2026.

NTT's SV1 data center in Santa Clara, California is the first of its kind to utilize base isolation technology to protect its clients from the region's earthquakes. The facility's construction began under RagingWire in 2018, but the company was fully integrated into NTT in 2019. The facility was planned to open in 2020, but was delayed due to COVID19 before opening in April 2021.
NTT is planning to build its third data campus for Berlin. The new campus is located in Brieselang near Berlin. Construction is expected to start in 2025.

The DataBank ATL1 data center, located in Midtown Atlanta, Georgia, is a facility within the CODA development at Georgia Tech's Technology Square. Georgia Tech's research lab serves as the facility's anchor tenant, which provides 10 total MW of critical IT load, with plans for expansion.

In July of 2022, NTT Global broke ground on the sixth data centre on its Ashburn campus. VA6 will offer 17,465 square metres of infrastructure and 24 megawatts of IT load. Construction is expected to complete in early 2024.

This facility was opened in 2005 by RenTech, a Nashville-based data center operator. RenTech was acquired by Peak10 in August 2006. Peak10 opened the "Nashville 4" facility in 2015, adjacent to the original site. Following Peak10's acquisition of ViaWest in 2017, the companies rebranded as Flexential in January 2018, and the two facilities now operate as one. The data center has a critical load of 1.49 MW and a gross area of 19,150 square feet.

VIRTUS is in the process of entering the Milan market. They acquired a 7 ha plot of land in Cornaredo, west Milan. The facility will offer 70 MW of total power over 44 000 sqm and is projected to launch in 2027.

Situated in the north of Paris, PAR1 first opened in 2000 under Interxion. The PAR1 facility is a part of Digital Realty's Paris hub, which is a network consisting of 10 data centres which are located across 3 zones in the city.

icolo.io is part of Digital Realty and its MBA2 data centre is located in the north of Nyali which is a residential area and Sub-County within Mombasa City. The new facility currently under construction will be the company's third data centre overall close to subsea cables landing points in Mombasa and is planned to go live in 2022.

A 3-building campus, this facility was acquired by Penta Infra from Sungard Availability Services in January of 2023. Upon acquiring the site, Penta began renovating the facility to update and expand its capacity and functionality. The site consists of two data centre buildings and one workplace building, covering a total of over 16,000sqm.

In October, Viettel unveiled plans to construct 24 data centres with a total capacity of 560MW, along with four new undersea fibre optic cable routes. These initiatives are reportedly part of Viettel's long-term plan to meet 60% of the country’s international connectivity demand by 2030.     The exact development timelines are currently undisclosed.
In Q4 2023, it was announced that the New Albany City Council had approved Edged Energy's plans to develop a data center at this property. Live as of Q3 2025.

This facility was built by Flexential in 2007, when they were trading as Peak10. It was the second data centre opened by them in Nashville, after the facility at 7100 Commerce Way that they acquired from RenTech in 2006. The site was then expanded in 2012 to house their third Nashville facility. Peak10 rebranded to Flexential in Jan 2018, upon their acquisition of ViaWest in the previous year. The data centre now maintains 3.15 MW of critical IT load within a gross building area of around 6940 sqm.

Takoda data centre is a new project of TIVIT's data centre. It is located in Rio de Janeiro and opened in 2012. It is the second Takoda's data centre to open in Brazil. Please note that Takoda is a separate company from TIVIT.
In 2025, Nebius with DataOne is developing an AI-ready 300MW data center in Vineland, New Jersey. The facility is being built with dedicated infrastructure for both power and cooling.
Montana Property Group LLC filed for a campus in Griffin, GA. This campus will have 2.55 million sqft with the first phase completing in 2030.
Swisscom's latest data centre is located in Bonvillars, east of Neutachel. It was purchased from PMI in Q4 2024.

Interxion´s ZUR2 data centre is located in Opfikon in Zurich, Switzerland. The facility is the companies second facility in that area after the ZUR1 and has been put in operation since 2020 providing a total building area of 13,000 sqm.
This facility is one of three by Internet Initative in the Kansai region. The company's other two data centres can be found at Dojima and Kozu.

Plans for SYD3 were first announced in November 2021. The facility will be located in Western Sydney, close by to AirTrunk's first Sydney build, SYD1. Once completed, SYD3 is set to be AirTrunk's biggest campus in Sydney. Land clearing began in Q4 2023 shortly after gaining SSD approval.

T5's Charlotte Campus consists of four data centers occupied by enterprise customers, along with a powered shell facility at 131 Riverside Ct, which was completed in 2015. This shell design has the potential to expand by an additional 64,583 square feet. The campus also includes three parcels of land, measuring 23 acres, 17 acres, and 14 acres, which remain available for further data center development.
AirTrunk are planning their second Melbourne project with a 240MW IT load in partnership with Hines.

DataBank's Silicon Valley data center is located in Santa Clara, California. The 2,500 square metre building was opened in 2011 by Server Farm Realty and was bought by Zayo's ZColo in 2016 before Zcolo's US and UK locations were acquired by DataBank in late 2020. SV1 offers 1,263 square meters of data hall space and 3 megawatts of IT power.

Across 15,621 sqm of data hall, Ascenty's data centre named Sao Paulo 2 located in Sao Paulo opened in 2017. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.

In August 2025, GIGA-42, a newly-formed joint venture between Global Interconnection Group and Scale-42, signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Norðurþing Municipality, Iceland to develop a 50MW AI data centre at Bakki, Húsavík.     GIGA-42 is targeting a final investment decision in 2026.

This facility is being built inside the Spencer building located at 515 W Hastings St, Vancouver. The historic Spencer building has undergone multiple uses since beginning as the flagship department store for David Spencer Limited in 1925. It was integrated into the Harbour Centre office and observation tower in 1977, and is currently being used as the the downtown campus location of Simon Fraser University, as well as for government and business use. The adjacently located Harbour Centre at 555 West Hastings Street hosts the data centres of Cologix, Cyxtera and eStruxture. The company Spencer Building Carrier Hotel (SBCH)is part of the Polaris Realty group that owns Harbour Centre. SBCH is headed by the former director of data centres of Cogeco Peer 1, acquired by eStruxture in 2021. The facility will be the landing point of Cascadia fibre artery that is to connect Vancouver to Seattle.

One of two projects in Texas for Blueprint Data Centers, their Georgetown location is just 35 miles from Austin on a 10 acre plot.     A phased development, their first phase is expected to encompass 12.5MW going live Q4 2026, with the second phase offering the same amount of power to go live the following quarter, Q1 2027.     Blueprint Data Centers secured an investment from Northampton Capital Partners in H1 2025. Both of their Texas sites are also benefitting from a 10 year, 50% property tax abatement.
Although used as a telecommunications center, colocation is also offered at Softbank's Omiya Center.

Iron Mountain's AZS-1 is located in Phoenix's northeastern suburbs, providing 121,00sqft of data hall space on a 4.5-acre site.  With 5.8 MW of power it is expandable to 9.6 MW for future requirements.
Located in central Sydney, this facility was previously under SIS Hosting, which rebranded to Amaze in January 2016. This facility was operational since 2009.

First built under Interxion, Digital Realty's PAR2 site forms part of the company's data centre network across Paris. The site is in close proximity to several other Digital Realty facilities which are located in Aubervilliers.

Digital Realty's 2045 & 2055 Lafayette Street data centers in Santa Clara, California were built in 2001. Digital Realty acquired the facility in 2004 and fully leased it to Savvis. In 2007, Microsoft acquired that lease and is now the sole tenant of the facility.

This facility is Tract's second in the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center. Sitting directly next to the Peru Shelf site, it is intended for hyperscaler clientele and build-to-suit facilities. There is no RFS date yet, as the site is still in the planning stages.
ZUR3 is arranged over 6 levels and is connected to the existing ZUR2 data centre via a bridge. It holds the most power of any site in Digital Realty's airport cluster.

Keihanshin Building is one of the few data centre-only building leasing companies in Osaka, and have more than 30 years experience in developing highly convenient urban data centres.     The Toyosaki building was completed in 1999 and the gross floor area is 3365 sqm.

AgileDC entered into a joint venture with Koguma DC Holding, a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary of Goldman Sachs, in February 2021. AgileDC is itself a wholly-owned subsidiary of Digital Colony II LP, the private equity fund of Colony Capital. In October 2021, AgileDC was acquired by Vantage Data Centers, who later dissolved the existing Joint Venture with Goldman Sachs. Originally expected ready for service in Q2 2025 with a first phase of 5MW, the campus will host 40MW of IT load within 2 four-storey buildings totalling 45,000 sqm of GFA on a 5-hectare site.     Plans for the campus has been updated to support 68MW of IT.     As of early March 2024, works appear to have started on site.  Building 1 was officially topped out in January 2025, and the campus is expected to begin operations in early 2026.
Teraco is a Digital Realty company. His ISANDO CAMPUS - JB7 is located in Sandton, Johannesburg. The facility is planned for completion in 2026.
Across a 6.3 ha plot, Equinix's data centre Amunategui opened in 2003 with 1.3 MW. It has a 1.5 PUE. It is a former Entel data center. Equinix acquired it in March 2022.

The Sarihyun-dong Data Centre is planned to span 3 basement floors and 3 storeys above ground, across over 40,000sqm of space.      Currently facing civil complaints, the data centre is expected to come live in 2028 at earliest.

This facility has an IT load of 10MW within 5669 sqm of colocation space. On July 2021, the facility was converted into a colocation data centre through the Telstra Wholesale Telstra InfraCo company, a telco infrastructure provider. If the colocation service proves to have high demand, 7 more of InfraCo's smaller data centres will also be converted.

Glenmarie DC Infra. 2 is the third data center of Basis Bay Malaysian portfolio, which opened in 2009. Also located in Glenmarie is DC Infra 1, that was designed to provide production and disaster recovery services.

CoreSite’s SV2 data center in Milpitas, California was opened in 2006. The 7,123 square meter facility offers high-density colocation with access to hundreds of cloud, network, and IT providers. SV2 is connected with CoreSite's SV1 facility and the Santa Clara campus.
Elea Digital acquired a former data centre and will renew all the facility and re-open at the end of 2024. It will open its expansion in 2026

This building was built by Keihanshin, one of the few data centre-only building leasing companies in Osaka, and have more than 30 years experience in developing highly convenient urban data centres.     The gross floor area is 16 162 sqm.

Located in Watford, CapitalLand Ascendas REIT's Chess Building spreads across 7,400 sqm of data hall.     The data centre was originally launched in 2008 by Sentrum Colo and was acquired by Digital Realty as part of the Sentrum Portfolio which included three data centres located in the London area. More recently, CapitaLand purchased the facility.
HopOne Internet's colocations facility is located in Tyson's Corner, VA. The facility offers private turn-key suites and boasts a record of 100% uptime.

Iron Mountain's NJE-1 data center was initially opened in 2011 as an IO Data Centers facility. The data center was retrofitted inside of a defunct New York Times printing plant located next to a power switching station.  The 830,005 sq ft facility sits on a 17-hectare plot of land. Iron Mountain has expanded the facility several times since its acquisition, and now offers 16.3 MW of IT load across 415,002 sq ft of data hall floor.

One of two Texas projects from Blueprint Data Centers, their Taylor site is located 35 miles from Austin with potentially 35 acres to utilize for the data center.     Developed in phases, the first phase is expected to be online Q4 2025 offering 20MW of critical IT capacity with phase 2 offering 40MW in Q1 2027. This will be provided by an on-site Oncor substation.
The Salt Lake City EdgeConneX Edge Data Center (EDC) is located in order to provide colocation facilities for customers wishing to deliver content and applications to local-market consumers.
In 2006 Sungard received planning permission to convert a 4,100 square metre warehouse into a combined data centre and disaster recovery / business continuity centre.

In October 2022, Conapto and Fastpartner signed agreement for the development of 10,000sqm data centre supporting 20MW of power. Phase 1 delivered 6 MW IT capacity in Q3 2024.     In October 2025, Conapto announced they have procured a further 8MVA to feed an expansion at this facility. It will cater to 18MW IT load at full build.
Across a 0.51 ha plot, Equinix's data centre opened in 2010. It is a former Verizon data centre. The data centre was named BG1. It opened with 2.8 MW of IT load.

Equinix's SV1 facility in San Jose, California was built in 1999 as the company's first data center. The facility benefits from its central Silicon Valley location through its interconnections to one of the world’s largest internet exchanges and peering points, a variety of both domestic and international network connections, and the booming business of the region.

Redcentric's facility in Gatwick initially opened as an Orange data centre in 2006, it was acquired by BT Global Services at the beginning of 2016 and subsequently sold to 4D Data Centres a the end of 2016 . In 2022, Redcentric purchased 4d data centres along with the Sungard's facilities. The facility offers retail services across 1,300 sqm of data hall.

Terakraft acquired a decommissioned power station from Sauda municipality in 2021.They then refitted the facility to operate as a data centre. iomart's data centre in Maidenhead, supports 2.7MW of IT load across 2800sqm of data hall. The facility was opened in 2007 by RapidSwitch and acquired by iomart in 2009.

Adista has several data centres located at Nancy, Bourges, Paris, and Marseille. They provide fibre cabling, telephone services, cloud services and managed services as well as colocation.

​The Open Origin AI data center project is a proposed development located southeast of Marfa, Texas, on an 80,000-acre site currently owned by Texas Mountain Cattle Company.      The facility proposed in Q2 2025 is designed to be powered primarily by on-site solar energy and may include a green ammonia plant to support low-carbon fuel production. However, the proposal has raised concerns among local officials and residents, particularly regarding the potential extraction of up to 800 acre-feet of groundwater annually—more than the current consumption of the entire city of Marfa. This has prompted discussions about water usage, housing availability, infrastructure, and the preservation of Marfa's renowned dark skies.      While the land sale has not been finalized, Open Origin intends to engage with the community as planning continues.​
