Middletown Data Centre in Middletown, VA went under construction in 2019, finished in 2021, and officially opened as a turn-key facility in May of 2022. The facility is 3,776sqm and offers 10MW of critical power.
Nabiax's third site in Alcala de Henares, this facility will offer 60MW of IT capacity for AI capabilities. Construction is expected to begin in H1 2026.

The Aventus 715 facility, located at 901 Commerce Drive, Marshfield, Wisconsin 54449, is a 20,000 sq ft colocation data center originally built and operated by Marshfield Clinic Health System. In April 2023, Marshfield Clinic announced an agreement to sell the data center to Aventus Data Centers, marking its transition from an in-house healthcare IT hub to a multi-tenant colocation facility.

This Digital Realty's in Charlotte, adjacent to their 113 N Myers St facility, was originally opened as a Pinnacle Telecom facility in 2000. In 2005, Digital Realty purchased Pinnacle's three Charlotte data centres. Digital Realty offers 2,360 sqm of total infrastructure space and 0.9 MW of critical load in this facility. A suite in the building is leased to Tierpoint and houses their 1.75 MW colocation facility.

This facility was opened by Flexential in early 2001 when they were trading as Peak10, prior to their 2017 acquisition of ViaWest. The facility previously also acted as Peak10's HQ. The facility was expanded in early 2009 and now offers 2 MW of IT load.
Edgnex acquired another plot of land in Greece as part of their expansion strategy.

NorthC plans to build its first data centre facility in Berlin. The Berlin facility set to launch in 2026 with its first phase will be the company's second data centre location after Frankfurt for Germany. The location of the facility is currently estimated.  construction start has not been disclose.

Red Wolf DCD Properties is planning a 600 MW hyperscale data center campus across 550 acres west of the Kansas Speedway in Wyandotte County, KS.   The development will include six data center buildings totaling approximately 1.98 million square feet, with construction on the first building and substation scheduled to begin in 2026.   As of Q3 2025, the project remains in the early stage.

Initially operating as Stellium 1, this Digital9 Infrastructure facility covers an area of more than 4,250m2 and is divided into four data halls. The first operational data hall is fully scalable. Stellium 1 datacenter has a tested power usage effectiveness (PUE) of 1.2 and conforms to the recommended operating parameters set by ASHRAE. It is one of the most efficient co-location datacenters in the UK and offers a competitive alternative to some of the best-regarded datacenters in continental Europe.
Sangam IT Center opened in March 2007. It is a high-riser, multi storey building with 12 floors above ground and 4 storeys at basement level.

First announced in Q4 2021 and opened in 2023, this data centre is a collaboration with Datafarm Energy. The facility is coupled with an existing agricultural methanation unit to extract power from bio-gas (recovery of agricultural bio-waste) and the building occupies 1000 sqm of gross area in the north-east of the city of Nancy.

In January 2022, T5 announced plans to build a 200MW data center campus on a 140-acre plot adjacent to Fort Gordon and the US Army’s Cyber Command Headquarters. Phase 1 is expected to serve 15MW of IT Load. In Q1 2024, T5 announced they are no longer developing this site and Eagle South LLC has filed a DRI for this area.
OneAs1a first data centre in China is located in the Pudong district, Shanghai. The facilty opened in 2017.     The building area is 26000sqm and the data centre provides up 12MW of IT Load.

365 Data Centers' facility in Herndon, Virginia offers 1,114 square metres of data hall space. The data centre was originally built as InfoRelay's headquarters in 1995. InfoRelay merged with Atlantic Metro in 2016, and the Herndon location was acquired by 365 in late 2020.

On 15th December 2020, Fingal Council granted K2 Data Centres planning permission to develop a new data centre campus close to their first and only facility, K2 DUB1, in Ballycoolin Business Park. The campus will ultimately comprise four data centre buildings which will be developed in two phases for a total capacity of around 60MW IT power. In its first phase 23,575 square metres of gross floor area was developed across two data centre buildings, with each one capable of supporting around 15MW IT power. The first and second phases are now live.

The Westfield Data Center Campus, developed by Servistar Realties, is a proposed hyperscale campus in Westfield, Massachusetts. Approved by the city, the project will include 10 data center buildings totaling 2.7 million sq. ft., built on  155.49-acre property.

55 Marietta St, owned by Westplan Investors, is an ideal alternative to leasing space in the adjacent 56 Marietta St, Atlanta's carrier hotel. The 21-floor building has over 172,222 square feet of occupied space, housing 16 carriers and several colocation and managed services providers, including CoreSite's AT1 colocation facility with 4 MW of IT load.     In 2010, the owners announced plans to renovate 204,514 square feet across the 10 unoccupied floors. With ongoing renovations, 12 MW of electrical capacity will be available as commissioned rack space or powered shell suites.
STACK plans to build a 48 MW facility in Melzo, east of Milan.

Aventus Lakes is a Tier III SOC 2 colocation facility in Milwaukee at 7901 West Clinton Avenue. With a building of about 26,432 square feet that includes roughly 10,900 square feet of fully built white space. Aventus acquired the site on November 2, 2022 and has been completing a multi million dollar upgrade program to align technical, security, and support standards. One of two active Wisconsin sites alongside Aventus 715 in Marshfield.
ST Telemedia India Private Limited opened its 2nd data centre in Chennai in 2010.     The facility serves up to 25MW of IT Capacity.
The Ilsan Center has 3 basement floors and 10 storeys above ground. The facility opened in 2007.

Web Werks announced their second facility in Mumbai. This facility will be a joint venture with Iron Mountain. Mumbai 2 will offer a total of 6.3MW. This data centre began operations in early 2023. In April 2025 it was announced that Iron Mountain was taking over Web Werks.

EPZ Tan Thuan Data Center was inaugurated in June 2013 and is located at Tan Thuan Export Processing Zone, District 7, Ho Chi Minh City. The facility was the first to receive Uptime Tier III certification in 2013.
VADS Brickfields Data Center was opened in 2015 and is located in Kuala Lumpur. The facility is TIA-942 Tier 3 certified.
In August 2025, Digital Realty applied for a 70MVA data centre in Macquarie Park.
ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC), Globe, and Ayala Corporation formed a joint venture in March 2022 to accelerate data center developments. The share ratio is 40%, 50% and 10% respectively.

Willowbend Capital LLC has executed a Memorandum of Understanding with Little Rock's mayor to authorize a data center project at Little Rock Port. This facility will cover 300,000 sqft and receive a 65% reduction in property tax for 30 years.

In Q4 2025, Garbe DC announced their conditional agreement to purchase 35 hectares of commercial land in Guldborgsund Municipality. Real estate developer Garbe aims to develop a 350 MW campus at the site which could host between six and nine data centre buildings.

Located in San Fernando de Henares and originally operated by Indra as a 2.5MW facility from 2012, in September 2021 the company announced the sale of the facility to XDATA Properties. XDATA announced they planned to expand the site to a 79MW Campus, expected to have a total of 8 buildings in phases. The company has since been acquired by Iron Mountain as of Q4 2022. The company has begun expanding the campus and the first phase of this expansion is set to complete in late 2025. Subsequently, the company intends to deliver 10MW by the end of 2026, 10MW in 2027, and the remaining 56MW by H2 2029.

In Q1 2025, it was announced that Substrate AI planned to build a 10MW colocation facility on a 25,000sqm plot next to the ongoing Meta development in the Torehierro Industrial Zone of Talavera de La Reina. The development is set to feature both a colocation data centre, alongside an AI research and development facility. The site's exact location is not clear.
CapitaLand has acquired land in Hanam for two data centres.

In Q2 2022, NTT-Netmagic announced they will be adding another facility to the Chandivali campus.     The facility will be called Mumbai 9 and is expected to go live in Q2 2023.     Once the data centre is fully complete the building will serve up to 62MW (6,000 racks).
In July 2024, Goodman applied to develop a data centre in Macquarie Park with a 135MVA capacity. This will require the demolition of existing structures on the site.

Bulk's DK01 Campus in Esbjerg, southwest of Denmark has been operational since Q4 2019.     Esbjerg is becoming a highly strategic data centre location with several subsea fiber systems terminating within or nearby. The facility is located 7km away from Esbjerg Train Station and around 54km away from the closest airport. The building is scalable to 3,900 sqm and the white space is scalable to 2,300 sqm. Currently, the facility is capable to support up to 10kW/rack. In 2022, Bulk Data Centers signed an option with Esbjerg municipality for adjacent 30ha land plot.

Pyeong-chon Mega Centre is owned by LG U+. The data centre facility comprises an office building and 2 data centre buildings. Each of the data centre buildings contain 7 storeys above ground level and 3 stories at basement level. 6 of those floors are data halls. Phase 1 (office building and the first data centre building) opened in 2015, while the second data centre building opened in 2020.

CBRE subsidiary Trammell Crow Company filed for a technology campus in Augusta, GA called White Oak Technology Park. The campus will total 8.076 million sqft with 8.004 million sqft being specifically for data centers. It is located on a 1945 acre plot of land with the first phase being developed by 2027. The remaining build out is planned over the next decade.

QST, a joint venture between Quantum Switch and Tamasuk, has signed an agreement with the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT) to develop and operate new data centres with a total capacity of 300MW by 2026 (coordinates unconfirmed).

H5's data center in San Luis Obispo was acquired in 2014. The 4,087 square meter facility sits on a half-hectare plot in proximity to US-Asia submarine cables. Tenants will have a number of options for leasing space including private cages and suites, powered shell build-outs, and the potential for expansion. The facility also boasts a 100% uptime record.
Net-magic Solutions is one of many subsidiaries NTT Communications have. Mumbai Data Center 6 otherwise known as NetMagic's D6 is located is the Powai region. It opened in 2018.
Nexspace's Viennese data centre will mark a first step into the market of the Austrian capital. Nexspace already has a data centre in Austria, though in Graz.

Equinix's SV10 data center in San Jose, Cafornia was opened in 2017. The 15,900 sqm building offers interconnections to one of the world’s largest internet exchanges and peering points, a mix of global networks and cloud services providers, and international carrier connections.

Atlantic Hub received planning permission for the first data centre at its planned campus in Foyle Port Innovation Park, Maydown, Derry, Northern Ireland. Planning permission for the four-story IT service and data centre building, along with generators and a substation, was granted by Derry City & Strabane District Council’s planning committee.  The project has been in development since 2018, with outline planning approval for four data centres secured in 2020. The 100MW site spans 12 hectares and could eventually expand to four buildings totalling 1 million sq ft (93,000 sqm) of technical space.  In October 2024, Atlantic Hub was acquired by investment firm DTCP who subsequently launched a new data centre platform GreenScale.  The campus is also located near two local power stations: Coolkeeragh Power Station and Lisahally biomass power station.

Metrobloks is planning its first U.S. data center in Miami, FL. This center will be 110,000 sqft and be located on a 4.05 acre parcel. The IT load of this facility will be 15.2MW and the center will offer liquid and air cooling, support rack densities up to 150kW. This site will also have an option to expand 16MW in Q4 2027.

Swisscom´s Bern-Wankdorf data centre is located in Bern in Switzerland. The Tier 4 facility has been in operation since August 2014 and is amongst the company's biggest data centres in Switzerland offering a total building area of 5,200 sqm.
DC Byte understands that there are pipeline plans by Digital Edge.

Equinix's LA2 data centre in Los Angeles, California was opened in 2000. Equinix operates out of the 6th floor of the 8-storey 818 Plaza, with 1,284 square metres of data hall floor and 1.25 MW. As an Equinix IBX data centre, the facility has an average uptime of more than 99.9999%.  The facility, with Equinix's other LA data centres, is a part of the Equinix Media Cloud Ecosystem for Entertainment- Equinix's model for optimizing content creation and media distribution.
This facility was opened by Q9 Networks in February 2011 and then acquired by Bell in June 2012 then by Equinix end of 2020. The TR6 data centre is to be expanded by 900 cabinets in Q2 2025.

Jan 2024, Bitera announced the completion of commissioning tests and is set to launch the facility officially in Feb 2024. The facility is reportedly 9 stories and has an IT load of 20MW over 8,600sqm of colocation space that can support up to 4,000 racks.

VIRTUS plans to build a second data campus in the northwest of Berlin in Wusermark. The new campus will consist of 8 data centre buildings, with its first phase planned to go live in 2027. A construction date has not been disclosed.

Quetta first bought this land from the local council in November 2023, the plot having previously been the location of an animal intervention and custody centre, alongside a municipal nursery. The site will host both the company's national headquarters and an edge data centre facility. The company announced via a LinkedIn post in Q4 2025 that construction on the site had started and that IT capacity will be scaled to 20MW. It will be ready for service in Q4 2027.

Operational since September 2012, IC2 is Macquarie's first facility at Macquarie Park Campus. Macquarie Data Centres is the master lessee of the existing shell and core and bought the freehold from Keppel DC REIT in April 2024 for $174 million.

InfoBunker is a data centre facility located in a government communications' bunker that was built to store sensitive electronic gear during the Cold War. The facility is over 6040 sqm, with all critical systems underground and has a total UPS capacity of 10MW.
The Chesterfield County Economic Development Authority has filed to rezone two properties in the county for data center use. The Magnolia Green property would consist of 970 acres.
KJDC opened in 2021 and is located in Petaling Jaya.
Gimhae IDC opened in 2011 with 1 basement floor and 3 floors above ground.
The International Information Port Data Center is located in Chang Ping district. Phase 1 came live in 2011.

This facility was acquired by Menlo in Q3 2024. It was originally reconstructed in 2002 as a purpose-built data center above retail shops on the ground floor. Portland Data Center now supports infrastucture to support the surrounding buildings and businesses.

This data centre is one of two facilities resulting from AgileDC's joint venture with Koguma DC Holding, a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary of Goldman Sachs. AgileDC is itself a wholly-owned subsidiary of Digital Colony II LP, the private equity fund of Colony Capital, and was founded in 2020. The JV was formed February 2021 and in October the same year, Vantage Data Centers acquired AgileDC. Following this, the JV with Goldman Sachs dissolved with Goldman Sachs taking the Tokyo site and Vantage keeping the Osaka project.

STT GDC announced the Fairview data centre campus in May 2023. The campus is scalable to 4 buildings, offering a development potential of 124 megawatts of IT load capacity once fully built. ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC), Globe, and Ayala Corporation formed a joint venture in March 2022 to accelerate data center developments. The share ratio is 40%, 50% and 10% respectively.
In June 2025, 1911 Data Centers, a new Polish player, announced they will build a 46 MW facility near Wroclaw, Poland. The first phase, consisting of 16 MW is projected to go live in Q1 2027.
DC Byte understand that are pipeline plans by Digital Edge.

KUL11 was renamed after the acquisition by Vantage Data Centers in December 2021. The facility was previously owned by MyTelehaus CJ1 data center that offered 3 levels of data halls totalling around 2407 sqm. The data center was later acquired by PCCW Solutions, a subsidiary of PCCW Global, in Q3 2020.

In Oct 2024, Keppel Data Centre Fund II (KDCF II) announced a joint venture (JV) with Digital Decarbonization Solutions Platform (DDSP). The joint venture will see KDCF II hold a 50% interest, with the remainder held by DDSP. The joint venture will develop a Tier III-equivalent greenfield data centre campus.

Located in Leuk, this facility provides colocation as well manged services to its customers. In September 2022, the company previously called Signalhorn renamed into Leuk Teleport & Data Centre AG. Solar panels as well as local hydro power provide the data centre with sustainable energy.
This facility was ready for service in 2H22.     A third phase of development was indicated in Q4 2023.

In June 2021, Al Moammar Information Systems (MIS) and Saudi Fransi Capital (SFC) announced a partnership to establish a Saudi data centre fund. The aim of this partnership is to ultimately reach 90MW of total IT capacity developed across multiple campuses.

Datacenter One is an Atlas Edge company operating its HAM1 data centre located in Ahrensbrug Hamburg. Atlas Edge acquired Datacenter One and its whole data centre portfolio in Stuttgart, Dusseldorf and Leverkusen in Q1 2023. The HAM1 has its opening in September 2023.

QTS acquired the facility for its Richmond data centre in 2010. The facility was retrofitted between 2010 and 2012 and offers 45,521 square metres of data hall floor. In 2022, QTS announced its acquisition of an additional 80 hectares for further campus expansion.
TK8 forms a campus with TK7, which began construction in Q1 2025.
PenDC's Bursa data centre went live in 2021, offering retail colocation services.

Colt Tokyo Inzai Data Centre Three is located in Chiba, Tokyo. Opened in November 2020, the facility offers 27MW IT load within 8,000 sqm of colocation space. Construction was by Inzai Development GK.

Plans for this facility were first highlighted in Singtel's 1H 2021 report. The site will contain the data centre and an integrated cable landing station, located right adjacent to the Tuas cable landing station. A ground breaking ceremony was held for the project in August 2023, with the facility scheduled to be operational in late 2025 or early 2026.

NorthC´s Datacube Biel data centre is a former netrics facility. The Tier 3 and some areas Tier 4 facility is located in Biel, Switzerland has changed ownership for the second time and was owned first by DataHub who put the facility in operation in 2018 with a total building area of 4,500 sqm.

Equinix announced their 3rd site is located in Mumbai. MB3 Is due to go live in Q4 2024 with phase 1 of 1,375 cabinets. The facility is expected to have future phases of over 4,000 cabinets. The site is located in Chandavali, near MB2.

In June 2021, Al Moammar Information Systems (MIS) and Saudi Fransi Capital (SFC) announced a partnership to establish a Saudi data centre fund. The aim of this partnership is to ultimately reach 90MW of total IT capacity developed across multiple campuses.
Formerly Solutions d’Hébergement Durable founded in 2013. Nexeren is a subsidiary of Xefi. In November 2019, a second building was added.

An unspecified developer has announced plans to build a $2.1 billion, 400 acre data center campus. The campus would house 14 three-story buildings.     Plans for this campus have been submitted through engineering firm LaBella Associates.

CAL-3 is the largest of eStruxture's planned or existing developments in the Calgary area. The $730 million facility is "AI focused" with a 70MW IT load in Phase 1. The initial load will go live in 2026.
CtrlS obtained two plots of land in 2023 in Chandan Valley Industrial Park for their Hyderabad Campus which will consist of 6 DC buildiings.

At the start of Q3 2021, Capitaland acquired Ascendas India Trust in which they annouced their first data centre project in Aroli. The data centre is located near Colt and Bridge Data centre.The facility will provide 61MW of of IT Load once complete on an 6.6 acre greenfield land. a-iTrust will invest INR 12 billion (161 million USD). Ascendas aimed to complete phase 1 by 2024.

In February 2025, AirTrunk announced the JHB2 hyperscale data centre with a capacity of 270MW, bringing its total platform capacity in Malaysia to 420MW. This expansion represents a total investment of RM 9.7 billion.

Located at Shenton Park, PE2 was one of the acquired assets following Equinix's acquisition of Metronode in 2018. This facility was Metronode's second facility in Perth. It also serves as a landing station for two submarine cables connecting to Perth.

CyrusOne announced its first facility in Madrid during the third quarter of 2021. The data center will ultimately deliver 6,000 sqm of technical space within a two-story building across two data halls with a total IT load of 18 MW. In Q4 2022, they began construction on phase 1 and this completed in Q2 2024.
Paix Data Centres plans to build its DKR-1 in Les Mamelles, Dakar. The new facility will be the company's first data centre in Senegal and is planed to go live in 2026.
Opened in April 2018, the Mitaka Data Center EAST holds 5,600 racks and a floor space of 38 000 sqm. (The Mitaka EAST building also contains the Tokyo 10 data center.)
The facility opened in 2017.
PE1 is located in East Perth. It was one of the acquired assets following Equinix's acquisition of Metronode in 2018. This facility was Metronode's first facility in Perth.

In April 2024, it was announced that QTS would be acquiring a Former Power Station site in Cambois. Britishvolt had previously planned to build a car battery factory on the site but the company fell into administration and the project was cancelled.     In September 2024, QTS submitted a 'Scoping Report' outlining their plans to build 10 buildings for a total footprint of 540,000 square metres. The report also stated that the facility would require 1.1GW of power to operate.     The outline planning permission was approved in May 2025. QTS has since applied for reserved matters to obtain full approval for the data centre before proceeding with the development.     In September 2025, the UK government's Department for Science, Innovation and Technology announced that this site will comprise part of the North East's AI Growth Zone.

In Q1 2022, Equinix bought their first site in Chennai. The facility is located in Siruseris’ SIPCOT IT Park. The facility is expected to accommodate up to 24MW of IT Load once complete.     Phase 1 of 810 racks has begun construction. It is expected add an additional 4,100 racks in future phases.

Herbata Ltd lodged an application with Kildare County Council on August 1, 2024, to develop a new data centre campus in Naas, County Kildare. The proposed project will consist of a six-building campus on a 37.5 hectare site located near the M7 Business Park. This land plot was one of two to receive a specific zoning for data centre development as per the Naas Local Area Plan 2021-27, with the other plot set to house Microsoft's Jigginstown campus. At completion the campus will total 180MW of IT Capacity.     Planning was approved for the project in August 2025, but appeals were lodged the following month on the grounds of its high emissions and high electricity consumption. A decision is expected in January 2026.
PAIX's ABJ-1 data center is located in Abidjan. The facility on the Ivory Coast is the company's only data centre in the country.
In Q4 2021, GDS announced their 3rd facility in Changshu. The RFS date of the facility has been delayed to 2026 and beyond.     This facility is under GDS' Yangtze River Delta portfolio.

After 6 years of planning applications and appeals, Art Data Centres' Ennis site was granted permission to build in April 2024 by An Bord Pleanala. However, various environmental groups sought a judicial review of this decision which was subsequently denied in Q1 2025 and so the project is set to continue.       The campus will consist of 6 buildings, providing around 120,000 sqm of data centre space at full build out, spread across 59 hectares of land.     The company have announced that construction will be phased over six years and began as soon as possible in 2024. The campus will have access to 200 MW of power from the network grid, as well as on-site gas power generation.

In Q4 2024, In late 2024, Archer acquired land in Faribault, MN to develop a 120 MW, 500,000 sq ft data center campus across six buildings. As of Q2 2025, the project remains in the early stage, with no RFS date announced.

The HH2/R2 data centre is located at the same location as its HH2/R1 facility in Hamburg. The former IPHH facility has been in operation since 2016. Arcus Infrastructure Partners acquired in Q4 2023 regional ISP operator Internet Port Hamburg and launched Portus Data Centers as a new European data centre platform.
ADL01 is DCI's first Adelaide data centre. The facility is located in the Western suburbs at Kidman Park. ADL01 is next to DCI's second data centre (ADL02) that is presently under construction.

This purpose-build data center will focus almost exclusively on AI and hyperscale leases. 400MW of power will be available in Q1 2027. A further 1400MW of power will be delivered from Q1 2031-Q1 2037. The property also includes solar batteries.

MY03 is located at Technology Park Malaysia in Bukit Jalil. Construction of the building was announced in 2021 and Phase 1 launched in Q4 2022, with Phase 2 following shortly after. The overall facility is reported to support an IT load of 16 MW combined.

B2 is located in Fortitude Valley, which fringes Brisbane's CBD. The facility went live in September 2017. Plans to build B2 were first announced two years prior, in late 2015. Development applications for the second stage of the campus was submitted in May 2023.

GDS' first Changshu data center campus is located in Changsu Comprehensive Bonded Zone. Phase 1 went live in Q3 2021 and phase 2 is scheduled to go live in 2026 and beyond.        This facility is under GDS' Yangtze River Delta portfolio.

This flat land area is fully mapped and has a valid build permit. The current site is 49 000 m2 but adjacent land offers 750 000 m2 of zoned area for future expansions. The site has a very strong power infrastructure including national overhead power lines of 2 x 300kV adjacent proposed site borders. The 22kV distribution grid is also bordering the site. The main substation is located 5 km from site and the local sub station is only 1 km away. Power is 100% renewable from 4 different power stations and options for heat reuse are available. Its phase 1 capacity is 20MW.

Goodman's MAD 01 site is their first investment in Spain and will offer up to 6 MW of IT service, in a 5240 sqm space. Construction is set to begin in 2026, and the first phase of the facility will be RFS in Q3 2027. The facility will be designed to offer liquid cooling, ready for AI capabilities.
Yexio's latest project involves the construction of a data centre in Bad Lippspringe, north of Paderborn. The facility is scheduled for completion in summer 2026 and will offer colocation services.
Located in east Prague, Kokura has been operational since 2015 and offers 3 MW of total power.

With a total colocation space of 7,000 sqm, Telehouse Voltaire is one of four facilities by the company located in Paris. The site is situated in the 11th arrondissement and is part of a larger multi-use building. In Q3 2024, the site began retrofitting to bring the facility up to modern environmental standards.

Expected to be operational in 2026 this project by Core Scientific to host Core Weave's NVIDIA GPUs will offer 70 MW of critical IT load for Phase 1 with the remaining 30 MW powering ancillary systems. A 600 MVA on-site substation is already constructed with access to 60+ acres, the company has stated that if they get approved for more power they can expand the project up to 500 MW of critical IT infrastructure.

NorthC´s Datacenter Nuremberg is a former IP-EXCHANGE a subsidiary of Q.BEYOND company. NorthC has acquired the subsidiary company in Q3 2021. The facility in Nuremberg, Germany has been in operation since 2004.

DFW3 is within DataBank's Plano Campus and was opened by the company in 2017 and has since undergone several stages of expansion. DFW3 is located near Legacy Park (Plano, TX) and is situated in the Dallas-Fort Worth Telecom Corridor, which means that the facility is able to offer availability to multiple dark fiber providers. It is also connected to DataBank’s DFW1 and DFW2 facilities via a data center interconnection (DCI) network which enables active-active DRaaS solutions.  They expanded the campus once more in 2025 adding DFW8 to the site and an additional 40.5MW of critical IT capacity.

In November 2024, TIM announced that they will be building a 25 MW data centre in Rome. The data centre will be located in the Tecnopolo Tiburtino technology park, east of Rome and is projected to be operational by Q4 2026. Coordinates approximate.
VA3 is part of CoreSite's large presence in Reston, Virginia. VA3 sits on an 8 hectare plot and, combined with the planned Reston expansion, will be able to house over 100 MW.
This property has applied for a zoning application for a data center in Twiggs County. They've bought 291.5 acres of land and will conduct a public hearing on Sept. 18 to decide on the request.

Arizona Land Consulting closed a $51 million land deal in Tonopah. The property spans approximately 2,100 acres and is positioned to support 1 GW of power, with plans to accommodate AI-related infrastructure.

In June 2025, Brookfield Asset Management announced their intention to build an AI campus in Strängnäs, Sweden. They will invest $10 billion in creating a campus which originally sought to deliver 300 MW, but may scale to 750 MW subject to additional land purchases.     The operator is currently unconfirmed, with Brookfield's data centre business Data4 currently the most likely.

The DataBank Chicago Tri-State facility is an 8.75 MW IT load facility located a 30-minute drive from downtown Chicago. This facility was purchased from Zayo in 2020 as part of a company-wide leveraged buyout. This facility features an 8000 sqm data hall with 8 onsite carriers and a Mechanical and Electrical redundancy of N+1.

Equinix's SV14's 2,080-square-meter data center in Santa Clara, California, offers 605 sqm of data hall floor. The facility, built in 2015, was acquired from Verizon in 2017. The center's Silicon Valley location allows access to one of the world’s largest internet exchanges and peering points, both domestic and international.

This purpose-build data center will focus almost exclusively on AI and hyperscale leases. Partnering with Nadia Partners, Beacon is primed to construct over 2GW of power across at least 6 projects outside of Calgary and Edmonton.

First announced in Q3 2025, Sierra DC's SP01 will be an AI-focused wholesale colocation data centre, with up to 100MW of electrical power in the CITAI district of Granada. Construction is due to begin in early 2026. 10MW of IT will be ready for service in Q1 2027. 100MWe will be ready by Q4 2028 and from 2029 onwards there will be potential to scale up to 210MWe.

Cologix's MIN2 is a 836 sqm, 0.5MW facility located in the 511 Building, also known as the Minnesota Technology Center. Cologix acquired the facility in its acquisition of The Minnesota Gateway in May 2012.
Phase 1 of HL1 began construction in Q3 2020 and came online in Q1 2021. Phase 2 started construction in Q4 2021 and will be ready for service in 2026 or beyond.      Location is undisclosed.

NTT´s Munich 2 data centre is located in Munich in Germany offering a total building area of 14,800 sqm consisting of two buildings. Building A has been put in operation in 2017 followed by the second building B which has been recently put in operation since July 2021.
Nagoya is Seznam.cz's second data centre that launched in 2023 and provides 3 MW of capacity.
This edge site in Jaipur will have an IT load of 6MW. The groundbreaking ceremony was held in November 2024.

Edged Phoenix, located near the Mesa Gateway Airport, is set to be operational in late 2025. The site will feature a two-story, 210,000 sq ft data center with 36 MW of critical load capacity on a 12-acre property. The facility will include an on-site substation, waterless cooling, and two meet-me rooms for connectivity.

Equinix's LA3 data center in El Segundo, California was opened in 2005. The 1-story, 10,000-square-metre building offers 7,276 sqm of data hall space. This site was first opened in 2000 under Hewlett Packard before the company announced in Q2 2017 that it would spin off and merge its Enterprise Services Division with CSC to create DXC Technology. This is the third building in STT's Navi Mumbai campus and will serve up to 40MW of IT load.

Originally planned to be a site in New Mexico, Sharon AI and New Era Helium have announced a joint-venture, called Texas Critical Data Centers, for a 250 MW natural gas-powered data center in the Permian Basin, West Texas. Yexio's latest project involves the construction of a data centre in Heiligenhaus is a town in the district of Mettmann. It lies between Düsseldorf and Essen. The facility is scheduled for completion in 2025 and will offer colocation services.

Aurora I was bought by CME Group in April 2016. Aurora II is located next to Aurora I. Construction on the facility began in December 2016 and  was opened in 2018. The facility is 39,762 sqm with  22,297 raised floor space.

EcoDataCenter plans to develop a large campus in Östersund. They secured a 31-hectare land parcel in Q2 2023 and aimed to begin construction of a 150 MW campus in 2025. Polarnode has reserved a 26-hectare industrial plot from Pori City Council for data centre development. AGP are planning a project in Melbourne. The project is expected to have a total IT capacity of 300 MW.

Plans indicate that both air- and liquid-cooled data halls will feature at the site, which has previously been used as a data centre for the past 14 years by a large Nordic IT company. Atea Sweden has been announced as one of the customers.

In November 2021, DayOne announced coming into definite agreement to acquire land plot in Nongsa Digital Park (NDP), Batam. DC Byte understands that Rack Central has pipeline plans for a facility within Pasir Gudang, featuring 9200 sqm of white space, a target IT load of 90 MW, and rack densities ranging from 8 to 140 kW.

Data Center Perg was constructed in 2010, catering to local clients in the Technologie Park Perg.

Gray Wolf Data Centers and ReNew Developers are planning a 10,000 square foot data center in Bristol, Connecticut. The facility is expected to begin construction in September 2025 and come online in Q4 2026.

Convergent VA LLC first proposed a plan for a data center campus in 2019. M-Net's Augsburg data centre typically services local clients, providing retail colocation services.

NTT plans to develop a new data centre campus in Rhein-Selz Park in Nierstein, a former US Army base outside Frankfurt. Fully built out, the campus is set to be the largest data centre campus in Germany.

A RFS date has not been announced but construction on the first phase is set to begin in 2026.

The Olive Urban data centre is a proposed €279 million project by Box2Bit, a subsidiary of Capital Energy, to be built on a 17,000-square-metre site in Málaga’s El Viso industrial estate. Box2Bit has also announced larger data centre projects in Aragón and Castilla-La Mancha worth €6.3 billion combined, though those remain in earlier planning stages.

Tract is planning a 447-acre campus on the former Emerald Greens Golf Course in Rosemount, MN. The project is expected to support 2.3–2.5 million sq ft across 12–15 buildings.  No construction has started yet.  As of Q2 2025, the site is undergoing environmental review via an Alternative Urban Areawide Review,

Initially opened by Lumison in 2004 and acquired by Pulsant in 2010. The facility will support 1.5MW of IT load once fully developed.  In July 2021, Antin Infrastructure Partners acquired Pulsant from Oak Hill Capital and Scottish Equity Partners.

Quantum Loophole officially stepped back from active involvement in the project. TPG is managing the development of this campus with developer Catellus Development Corporation.

Ark Cody Park is located in the Cody Technology Park, it comprises six data centres set over a 10-hectare site. Development is taking place in phases and upon completion, the data centre campus will spread across 33,500 sqm of data hall.

Codisa's data centres are located in Tecno Park in San Jose, Costa Rica. Is a three data centre complex. In 2006 the first building was opened, In 2009 the second building was opened, and In 2018 the third building was opened.

Cyxtera's Tampa data centre is a single story building with a roof built to withstand 130 mph wind speeds. Cyxtera are soon to attend a hearing to confirm their bankruptcy plan.

Equinix acquired this facility in its portfolio of 29 data centres it acquired from Verizon in 2017. It boasts almost 7000 sqm of colocation space and benefits from the same connectivity and security certifications as the rest of Equinix's Miami based data centres.

The second of EdgeConneX's purpose-built Miami data centres went live in 2017. Centersquare's IAD2-A facility is one of two buildings on its 4.4-hectare Sterling, VA campus. IAD2-A offers 2.9 MW of IT power.

Located in Chiba, Colt's Inzai 2 facility offers 15MW of IT Load. The 7-storey data centre went live in 2017 and houses almost 2000 racks. Each of the 10 data halls spans 500sqm each, totalling 5,000sqm of colocation space.

The Costa Rican Institute of Electricity (Instituto Costarricense de Electricidad) data centre opened in 2012. It has a Tier III certificate. Although is a Costa Rican government facility it provides retail services.
This media tower with data centre is located in Ittervoort, in the Limburg municipality of Leudal. The tower was built in 1989 and is 118 metres high.

AtlasEdge's Paris North facility is a former Colt data centre located in the 17th arrondissement of Paris. The site has been live since 2000 and changed ownership in Q4 2021 as a part of AtlasEdge's acquisition of twelve Colt data centres across Europe.

DCI-E1 Data Center Campus was announced in 2H 2022 and is located in proximity to IIX (Cyber 1) and Open-IX (IDC Duren Tiga). Equinix´s AM8 data centre, a former Telecity data centre, is located in the Westpoort area of Amsterdam. The facility has been operational since 2004 and was acquired by Equinix in Q2 2016. While located further from Equinix's other Amsterdam facilities, AM8 is still connected via the company's Metro Connect fibre.     In March 2021, CapitaLand Ascendas REIT acquired the land leasehold.

Equinix´s AM7 data centre is a former Telecity data centre, acquired in Q2 2016. Located in Zuidoost, the South-east area of Amsterdam, this facility has been operational since 2008 with the most recent, third expansion going live in Q1 2021. This facility is part of Equinix's Southeast Campus.

The Pewaukee data center at N15W24250 Riverwood Drive has gone through several ownership and tenant transitions since its development as an AT&T facility. In October 2013, AT&T sold the site to Carter Validus Mission Critical REIT in a sale-leaseback valued at about US$52 million, while continuing as the tenant. In October 2017 (Q4), Carter Validus sold the property as part of a US$750 million, 14-asset portfolio deal to a joint venture between Mapletree Investments and Mapletree Industrial Trust (MIT), giving MIT a 40 percent ownership stake. In June 2020 (Q2), MIT acquired the remaining 60 percent stake in the portfolio for US$211 million, consolidating full ownership of the facility. By 2022, MIT’s valuation reports listed the site at around US$51.7 million, showing stable value across multiple transactions. As of 2025, MIT remains the owner, but AT&T is no longer confirmed as the active tenant. Current listings market the building as formerly AT&T-occupied and available for multi-tenant or wholesale data center use, indicating that the site is now either vacant or partially unoccupied while seeking new tenants.

The Telia Helsinki Datacentre (HDC) is located in Pitäjänmäki, Helsinki, less than 20 minutes from the airport. The Data Center operates in accordance with sustainable and environmentally friendly principles. Fully fitted, data center is capable to support up to 5000 racks at 6.7kW/rack with a total capacity of 24MW. The data center is well connected with more than 20 different telecom and internet exchange providers present. With standard capacity up to 20kW/rack the center is good for enterprise, wholesales and high performance /HPC needs. The datacenter also has certified high security space available.

Equinix's EN1 facility is located in north-west Enschede, close to the German border. This facility was became operational in 2010 and is connected to Equinix's other Netherlands facilities through their Metro Connect fibre.

Gray Wolf Data Centers and ReNew Developers are planning an HPC/AI colocation facility in Colchester, Connecticut. The 3.5MW first phase of the development is expected to break ground in September 2025 and become operational in Q4 2026.

Maincubes AMS01 data centre located in the Schipol-Rijk area of Amsterdam. The facility offers more than 4,400 sqm of IT space with hot spots capable to support up to 20kW/rack. Deventer data centre is ITB2 first facility. It was taken into use in 2007. Facility has a total floor area of 450 sqm.

A new expansion has been planned in where phase one of the expansion is expected to be ready for service early in the first quarter of 2025.

Since acquiring the site, Switch Datacenters has carried out enhancements to the facility including allowing for extra capacity and improving on energy efficiency.

The GlobalConnect GC Albertslund in Albertslund, Denmark.

Located near Facebook's Lulea campus and scalable to 80MW, this facility is 100% powered by renewable energy. Initially a Canadian Hydro66 facility, it was acquired by bitcoin mining firm Northern Data in January 2021. Facility was sold for 4million euros cash and 21 million euros in shares of Northern Data. As with the previous owner, the facility will be utilised for AI and ML type HPC applications.     In Q4 2025, Northern Data was acquired by Rumble. Opened in 2010, the building gross area is 3 242 sqm with 7 data halls of 160 sqm (370 racks). This facility was acquired from CIV at end of 2022.

Global Cloud Exchange (GCX) is an subsidiary of Reliance Communication since 2002.  It is located in Dhirubhai Ambani Knowledge City (DAKC) with the capacity of 40MW. Located in downtown Seattle, the Westin Building Exchange is a 37,000 sqm building and has housed a range of colocation service providers since 2001. Digital Realty acquired a majority stake in February 2020. Housed data centers include Equinix SE2, DataBank, 365 data centers, and Colocation Northwest's Downtown Seattle Westin.

Located in Jersey and Guernsey, Sure operates two facilities in the Channel Islands. Jersey Data Centre's site spreads across 820 square metres with 490 square metres dedicated to white space. The facility is divided in two data halls with a total capacity of 250 racks.
European Data Hub offers approximately 5000 sqm of colocation space which is situated 22 metres underground at Cloche d'Or.

In April 2025 CtrlS announced plans to set up a 12MW AI-ready facility in Bhopal.

This facility was acquired through ISDNet, Cable and Wireless, Tiscali and Alice ADSL in August 2008 and renovated in 2009. Scaleway originally started as Online.net, the hosting and data center division of Iliad. In 2023, Scaleway's data centre unit was established into a new entity Opcore.

DC Byte understands that there are pipeline plans by Global Telecom to develop in Sedenak Tech Park.
Keppel DC Singapore 1 is a six-storey data centre facility built in 2001 and retrofitted in 2011 and 2013.

Announced in Q1 2025, Edged Energy and Merlin Properties stated they would be expanding their partnership to activity in the region of Extremadura. The site is one of two gigawatt facilities planned in the region where the companies plan to construct sites focused on generative AI and advanced computing. The site in Valdecaballeros sits on an unfinished and dismantled nuclear power plant and will consist of ten buildings of 100MW each.

Data Inn is one of Data Logistics Center facilities is Lithuania. It is the first facility in the country to receive Tier III certificates for design documents and the facility's completion of phase I.  In August 2021, the company announced plans to expand this facility by adding 500sqm of server space which was estimated to cost the company ~3million euros. The construction was completed in Q3 2022.
DC Byte understands that there are pipeline plans by Global Telecom to develop in Melaka.
Rechenzentrum Haßfurt's data centre came into existence in the early 2000's, offering retail colocation services to local SMEs.
H5's Cleveland, Ohio data centre is 32,608 square metres on a 1.5-hectare plot. The facility was purchased from ByteGrid in 2017 and offers 13,935sqm of data hall floor.

Located in Saint Ouen and opened in 2018, DC5 is designed as hyperscale infrastructure. Scaleway originally started as Online.net, the hosting and data center division of Iliad. In 2023, Scaleway's data centre unit was established into a new entity Opcore.

Operational since 2012, the facility, previously used as a music studio, had reached full capacity by 2016. (Scaleway originally started as Online.net, the hosting and data center division of Iliad.) In 2023, Scaleway's data centre unit was established into a new entity Opcore.
Green´s Zurich-North data centre is located on the outskirts of Zurich in Switzerland. The two-storey facility has been operational since 2002 and provides a total building area of 2,010 sqm.

In early 2022, CloudHQ acquired a 40-hectare plot of land in Culpepper, Virginia. The plot currently has access to 30 MW of power, and CloudHQ is planning to build three data centres on the land. The campus is intended to provide 142 MW of critical load across 88,646 square metres of infrastructure.
Khazna's entry into the Turkish market comes in the form of a 100MW data centre located south-west of Ankara. Khazna is set to appoint a general contractor for the project in Q2 2025.
The Adeo Datacenter in Copenhagen, Denmark. The data center is a 1,200 sqm Tier3 modern datacenter running full cloud services, more traditional hosting services.

eStruxture's MTL-4 data centre began as a Cogeco facility. Announced in Q3 2012, Cogeco, along with the recently acquired Peer 1 Hosting, planned to open their Montreal data centre in 2014. The facility was opened in September of 2015 with 9,290 square metres of space and 16.5MW of total planned power capacity. Cogeco soon expanded the facility in 2016, adding 279 square metres of total space.     The single-tenant facility was acquired by Aptum Technologies in 2019, and finally became eStruxture's MTL-4 after the company's acquisition of Aptum's Canadian data centres. The facility currently has four data halls across 3,344 square metres of white space.

Hyperco has begun construction on a data centre in Kouvola, 100km east of Helsinki. Phase 1 will involve the construction of a 28,000 sqm data centre on a 10-hectare site.     Announced in Q2 2025, ByteDance will be the tenant for this project. They aim to invest $1bn here as the most recent instalment of their "Project Clover" initiative.     Also in Q2 2025, Hyperco was acquired by the Dubai-based DAMAC Group and subsumed under its DAMAC Digital data centre platform.
Noris Network´s NBG5 data centre is located in Nuremberg in Germany. The data centre is the third facility in the city of Nuremberg and is part of one of the three data centres in that location.
In September 2025, Lumina has reportedly acquired two adjacent land parcels in Mumbai’s Chandivali area to build two data centers.
envia TEL´s Datacenter Leipzig is located in Taucha in Germany. The facility is the company's first data centre in Taucha and has operated since 2014.

Global Switch’s second data centre in Singapore will be in Woodlands, to the north of the Island and physically distanced from the two main existing data centre concentrations in the east and west.  The building has 5 data floors. It is connected to 30MVA utility power and offers 1.5kW/sqm as standard with higher power density available.

Sentia acquired this data centre in 2016. Since data centre services is not the core business of Sentia, in Q2 2021, the facility was sold to Penta Infra. Penta Infra finished the expansion of CPH01 facility and it currently now has 1.6 MW total IT capacity.
Menlo Digital acquired this site in 2021, and announced plans to scale up the existing colocation facility as part of its initial portfolio of sites announced in 2025.
In April 2025, NTT announced a ₹10,500 crore investment to set up an AI Data Center in Hyderabad. The project is expected to have a load of 400MW.

Oppidan is building a single story, 90,000sqft facility in Carol Stream, Illinois.  The company broke ground on the 11-acre site in Q4 2024.  Nearing Completion as of Q3 2025 with an expected RFS of Q4 2025.   No end user has been announced as of Q3 2025.

LCL´s Brussels-West data centre is located in Aalst, situated between Brussels and Ghent. The facility consists of two data centres where its first building went live in 2011 and completed its first expansion in April 2014. In November 2019, LCL set aside € 15.5 million to expand its Brussels-West location. That sum also included the purchase of the adjacent land with a view to future expansion.
PowerHouse is constructing a campus in Chester, Virginia. The campus will offer around 300MW across up to five buildings and is expected to come online in Q3 2027.

Pulsant's data centre in Reading spreads across five data halls. Located close to Redcentric's facility in Reading, Pulsant's data centre opened in 2013.      The facility was originally owned by Amito and was acquired in Q1 2022 in a deal which included this data centre.

Rowan Digital Infrastructure’s Project Cinco is a $900 million hyperscale build-to-suit data center campus spanning roughly 440 acres in Medina County, Texas. The 300 MW facility is planned to include seven buildings and is expected to be fully operational by 2027.     Construction began with a groundbreaking ceremony in Q3 2025, and the first 60 MW phase is expected to be live in early 2026.

Equinix's NY11 data center was opened as a Verizon facility in 2002, expanded in 2010, and acquired as an Equinix facility in 2017. The 129,166 sq ft facility offers 91,417 sq ft of data hall floor.  Equinix's IBX facilities across New York and New Jersey provide low-latency connectivity to major financial institutions as well as ad-tech companies.

Originally opened in 2000 as an In Technology data centre, it was acquired by Redcentric in 2013. The facility is located in Reading close to Amito Reading. Redcentric's data centre spreads across 1400 sqm of data hall.

PFALZKOM´s DCRN II data centre is located in Mutterstadt in Germany. The facility is the companies third data centre in Frankfurt and has been operational since 2017 providing a total building area of 3,500 sqm.

Datacenter United´s Brussels facility is located in Zaventem, north-east of the capital. The two-storey facility has been in operation since 2012 and is the companies third data centre providing a total building area of 1,200 sqm.
NTS Colobern South data centre is located in Bern in Switzerland. The facility is the company's first data centre in Bern and has been in operation since 2008.
44274 Roundtable Plaza (Bldg L) is located in Ashburn, VA. This 2 storey building is 98,199 sqm built on 9.57 hectares of land and has 96 MW of IT load.

This facility in Hawthorne, California was originally built by AT&T in 2001 before being acquired by Evoque at the end of 2018. The facility is conveniently located less than 10 kilometers from Los Angeles International Airport. The 26,810 square meter building offers 3,725 sqm of data hall floor. The building was bought in Q2 2021 by Mapletree Industrial but is still operated by Evoque.
Nxtra launched Pune 2 in 2019.  The facility serves up to 20MW of IT Load.

Evoque's data center in Redwood City was retrofitted in 2013. The 11,033 square meter facility offers 5,774 sqm of data hall floor and 1.5 MW of IT power. The earthquake-resistant facility is conveniently located just 15 miles from San Francisco International Airport and 4.5 miles from Palo Alto.
Centersquare's data center in Boston, Massachusetts, was opened in 2002 by Evoque. The facility offers 201,586 sq ft of total infrastructure.
Green´s Metro Campus Zurich is located in Dielsdorf close to Zurich in Switzerland. The campus which is the company's second campus for Zurich went live in Q1 2023 with the first of three buildings.
NTS Colozueri.ch data centre is located in Zurich in Switzerland. The facility has been in operation since 2007 and provides 1,000 sqm building area.
Located 15 miles north of Seattle, Centersquare SE1 data center is a 9,650 square-meter building with 4,682 square meters of raised floor space.
The facility is part of the new VIRTUS Stockley Park Campus, with London 8 comprised of over 7,000sqm net technical data centre space.

TeraWulf has announced the execution of a long-term ground lease for 183 acres at the Cayuga site in Lansing, New York, providing the company with exclusive rights to develop up to 400 MW of data center capacity, with 138 MW expected to be ready for service in 2026.
Stack Infrastructure has plans for a second campus in Melbourne with a total IT capacity of 252MW.

Portus Munich is located in Kirchheim near Munich. The data centre is a former SDC SpaceNet DataCenter that opened in 2019 with its first phase. Arcus Infrastructure Partners acquired SDC SpaceNet DataCenter GmbH & Co, KG from German ISP SpaceNet AG. The new portfolio is part of the Portus Data Centers new European data centre platform in Luxembourg and Hamburg.

It was published in January 2025 that Keystone has submitted planning to develop two separate data centres on the IPM site in Be'erTuvia Industrial Zone. Each site will spread across 15,000 square metres.

Located in the neighbourhood of La Villette, near to the port of Marseille, MRS1 first opened in 2001 as the SFR Netcenter. The facility was then acquired by Interxion in 2014. The colocation space has 6.7MW of critical IT load.

ACS Group, through a partnership with energy provider Benbros, is planning a €1.2 billion hyperscale data centre campus on a 50‑hectare site in La Puebla de Alfindén, just outside Zaragoza in Aragón. The project will launch with an initial 150 MW phase and includes plans for grid connections and integration with local renewable energy sources. Construction is expected to begin in late 2026 with operations starting in the first half of 2027.
Teraco´s DB1 data centre is located in Newlands, South Africa. The facility has been in operation since 2011.

YTL Johor Data Center 6 is designed to support an IT load of 40MW and accommodates 52RU rack configurations. The facility offers a floor loading capacity of 15kN/sqm and does not include raised floor provisions. It is designed with a power usage effectiveness (PUE) target of below 1.4.     The facility incorporates a concurrently maintainable, distributed redundant low-voltage (LV) power distribution system serving both IT and cooling loads. Cooling is provided by an N+1 chilled water system with a thermal buffer storage tank. Fan wall units (FWUs) are located within a service corridor to support efficient airflow and maintenance access.

Opened in 2018, this facility has required the refurbishment of sections of Marseille Fos Port. Interxion has stated that the facility was installed in 'former naval workshops, Freyssinet-style buildings, vacant since 1990's' (ateliers Fouré-Lagadec).
Centersquare's Secaucus data centre was opened in 2001 by AT&T, and was acquired by Evoque in early 2019.

Opened in 2007 under Interxion, PAR3 forms part of the Digital Realty Paris network of data centres which is spread over three zones in the city. The site is situated in the northern zone, within the neighbourhood of La Plaine-Saint-Denis.

EUNICE Energy Group received national funding to develop a data centre in Western Macedonia. The data centre will align with Greece's decarbonisation efforts harnessing energy from renewable energy sources. The investment will amount to 31.5 million euros.
B1 is NEXTDC's first facility in Brisbane. It is also NEXTDC's first data centre to go live. The facility was first ready for service in October 2011.

In 2012, NewTelco opened its latest, brand-new, purpose-built premises – NewTelco Georgia – to become the first carrier-neutral data centre in the whole Caucasus region. The facility is located in the central part of Tbilisi. NewTelco’s data centre has been designed and equipped according to international standards, offering its customers a full range of ICT solutions.
The land for this facility was acquired in April 2011 and development approval was granted January 2012. Opened in February 2014, this facility is located in Malaga.

The Ecogrid Energy Park Pori project is a joint venture between Ecogrid Energy, NCC and Compass Forge Ventures to establish a data centre campus in Raisio. The companies will establish a data centre alongside green power plants on the same 37-hectare plot in Kupariteollisuuspuisto, Pori (Copper Industrial Park). They will also seek an international data centre operator for the site, which aims for 150MW electricity demand in phase 1, with 300MW at full build. The site is already zoned and is currently in the design and permitting phase. Compass Forge currently estimate that construction can begin as soon as H2 2025. In Q4 2025, ASP Datacenter announced that they have acquired the site. They aim to begin construction in H1 2026.
RJ04 is going to be the third Elea´s Data Centre. It will be part of the Elea AI City Data Centre project.

Stream's DFW VII data center is located in Garland, Texas. The first phase of the campus opened in 2019 with 3MW and has since been expanded to provide 43MW of critical IT capacity. Since 2023 the campus has been fully leased and it is powered  by two utility feeds from a 95MW on-site Oncor substation. The facility also offers customers the option of 100% renewable energy.
Located at Grenoble, this is Alpilink's second data centre facility, with the company's other base of operations located in Digne les Bains.
Building receives 2MVA power from 2 utility sources. Telehouse's data centre is located in building 750D within BizPark @ Chai Chee owned by ESR.
Elea AI City will have 3.2GW. The first phase is expected until 2028 with 1.5GW.

Located in Buckingham Avenue, the facility is located next to NTT Slough 1, and Virtus' Slough Campus. LON3 spreads across 6660 sqm of data hall.

Q4 2023, Nvidia and YTL announced a $4.3 billion investment in artificial intelligence cloud and supercomputer infrastructure in Malaysia. The project is known to be hosted at YTL Green Data Centre Park in Kulai.     YTL Johor Data Center 2 is designed to deliver 20MW of IT load and supports 52RU rack configurations. The facility has a floor loading capacity of 15kN/sqm and does not include a raised floor.     It features a concurrently maintainable, distributed redundant low-voltage (LV) power distribution system serving both IT and cooling infrastructure. Cooling is provided through a concurrently maintainable N+1 chilled water system with an integrated thermal buffer storage tank. The facility is also equipped with direct-to-chip liquid cooling capability, supporting high-density workloads and AI deployments.
In Q2 2025, SUB1 submitted a full planning application to develop a data centre in Aston, Birmingham.

Rackspace's Kansas City, Missouri data centre is a 7,200 sqm, two-storey building located on a 2.1 hectare plot. The facility was originally constructed in 1982 but has undergone renovations in 2009, 2012, and 2015. The facility has 3.5MVA and 1.5MW of critical IT load spread accross three data halls totally 1,435 sqm. Rackspace took over the facility from Datapipe in 2017.

Vantage's Santa Clara I campus consists of six data centers. These facilities offer a total of 77 Megawatts of IT load and have access to three 50 MW, on-site substations. Both dark fiber and lit fiber services are available across the campus, and each building contains a meet-me-room.

Datacenter United´s Antwerp facility is is one of three original data centres in its portfolio, with one of the others also being in Antwerp and the final in Brussels. This facility has been in operation since 2010 providing a total building area of 4,680 sqm. This facility is the first and only in Belgium with a Tier IV certificate awarded by the Uptime Institute.

M9 data centre is a 19-storey building otherwise known as MMTC-9 (Moscow International Telecom Exchange). The building was built in 1978. At that time, it was the most technologically advanced telecommunications industry building in the USSR. In 1993 digital stations were launched in the facility. In 1998, the first telecommunications operator set up a small centre which was the beginning of first Russian Internet. The facility has significantly expanded since then and it is now the most connected telecommunications building in Moscow. Facility was mordernised to nowadays data centre in 2013. In January 2022 the new data hall will launch.

Moscow-I Data Center is situated in Moscow, at the intersection of Volgogradsky prospect and the Third Ring Road (Ostapovsky proezd 22/16 and 22/13). Moscow-I Data Center became operational in September 2007.

Moscow-II Data Center — located in Academician Kurchatov square (Akademika Kurchatova pl. 1, bldg. 119, Moscow) — was built in cooperation with National Research Centre “Kurchatov Institute”.  Moscow-II Data Center became operational in 2014. Data center infrastructure complies with international standards for data center design and construction.

Data center Moscow-III, located at pl. Akademika Kurchatov, 1, p. 14, 15, 148, built in cooperation with the Russian Scientific Center "Kurchatov Institute".     The data center was commissioned in 2017. The infrastructure of the data center was built in accordance with the requirements of world standards in the field of creating data centers.

This site marks Powerhouse's entrance to the Indiana market, with 170-acres on the property currently planned for up to six data center buildings with an on-site substation.     NIPSCO plans to bring 450MW to the site with the delivery of the first building in 2027.
EdgeConneX's EDCAMS02 facility is 7191 sqm and provides 20MW of total IT capacity.
In Q1 2025, NEXTDC submitted planning documents for their SC2 facility in Maroochydore.
This facility was acquired from Australian Pacific Data Centres (APDC) on September 2019 and has a capacity of 180 racks and 1.5MW IT load.

Located in Alcobendas, DATA4's MAD01 Campus was announced at the end of 2019 with the first phase being deployed in Q4 2020. In May 2021, DATA4 announced the acquisition of the annexed site. Upon reaching the final phase of development, the campus is expected to support 6 data centres across 25,000sqm and hosting a 70MW IT space capacity.
One of DCU's newest facilities. This site is being retrofitted to provide 1MW of IT capacity.

LCY10 will be Echelon's first data centre in the UK. The facility is located in the Docklands and spreads across 6,000 sqm of data hall.     The development was announced in 2019 and we expect the first phase to be delivered in 2022.

Vantage's Quebec campus comprises three data centres of 8MW (2014), 12MW (late 2019) and 34MW announced March 2022 and RFS in 2023. This data centre is also funded through debt financing from Société Générale.
eStruxture acquired its CAL-1 data centre in 2019 from Shaw Communications. The 6,038 sqm, 6 MW facility was initially retrofitted in 2015. The data centre offers 3,717 sqm of data hall floor.

Sabey's Intergate.Manhattan data center was originally built in 1975 as a switching center for the New York Telephone Company, later Verizon New York. Verizon sold the building to real estate company Taconic in 2007, and Sabey purchased the facility in 2011.  After renovating four floors for data center use, Sabey opened the facility in 2013. Sabey further expanded in 2020 and now offers 5.7 MW of IT load.
Cologix's ASH1 data centre is located on an 8-hectare plot in Ashburn, VA: the data centre capital of the US.

Located in central Christchurch, Gloucester is a carrier-neutral colocation data centre. Originally opened a few weeks before the first Christchurch earthquake, the facility was upgraded in 2019 from 52 racks to 136, with capacity to add 60 more.

NTT's VA5 data centre is one of seven data centres NTT plans to build on its massive 31.5-hectare plot in the renowned "Data Centre Alley." VA4 and VA5 are nearly identical in design; both will offer 32 MW of IT power across their four respective data floors.
Location on Auckland’s North Shore, Orbit is a carrier neutral colocation data centre. It was expanded in 2019 from 800 to 1100 racks.
In September 2025, Firmus received approval from the city council to begin work on their 90MW AI data centre.

CloudHQ is expanding its presence in the APAC data centre market with the development of a campus in Chonburi, Thailand. This project will deliver 108MW of IT capacity, supported by an on-site substation.
Situated in Hamilton, Kapua (Maori for cloud) is sister to Datacom's Orbit data centre. 184 racks were added as part of an expansion in 2019.

company_name: Da Nang International Data Centre JSC
overview: Da Nang International Data Centre JSC has announced a 1,000-rack data centre at Da Nang Hi-tech Park with an initial investment of 800 billion VND (USD 32 million). The facility will support cloud, AI, and cybersecurity services. Operations are expected to begin between 2026 and 2027, with a second-phase investment of 1.2 trillion VND (USD 48 million).
Prism Capital Partners has proposed a data center on its 116-acre ON3 campus in the Township of Nutley and Clifton, New Jersey
QTS purchased their main Irving building in 2013 and have since planned to build a 6-building campus at full-build, with the 5th and 6th data centers being on the adjacent plot of land.
Ascenty's data centre named Sumaré1 located in Sumaré, Sao Paulo opened in 2017. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.
Ascenty's data centre named Campinas1 located in Campinas opened in 2012. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.
Ascenty's data centre named Vinhedo1 located in Vinhedo, Sao Paulo opened in 2020. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.

SNC Data Hills plans to build a campus consisting of 3 buildings in the PSA business park. This project is located just 30 metres from another proposed data centre project by company Data Fifty which is still in the early stages of conception.     This development consists of 3 buildings and will total 160MW. All permits were approved in Q3 2025 and 240MVA of power was secured in 2020. Construction is planned to begin H1 2026.
Ascenty's data centre named Jundiaí1 located in Jundiaí, Sao Paulo opened in 2014. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.
Ascenty's data centre named Jundiaí2 located in Jundiaí, Sao Paulo opened in 2019. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.

Prime Data Center's new Santa Clara facility began construction in Q4 2020 and is planned to be completed in Q4 2021. The 11,241 sqm center sits on a 1-hectare plot and will offer 9MW upon completion. Its location allows it to benefit from Silicon Valley's incredible data infrastructure.

In a complex of 6 Data centres, Ascenty's data centre named Hortolândia 2 located in Hortolândia, Sao Paulo opened in 2019. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.
Ascenty's data centre named Fortaleza 1 located in Fortaleza, Ceara opened in 2015. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.

Now Centersquare, this facility was Cyxtera's EWR1 data center in Jersey City, New Jersey. It was initially opened by CenturyLink and acquired in 2017. The 74,217 sq ft suite offers 22,851 sq ft of data hall space and 3.6 MW of IT load.

Across 7,000 sqm of data hall, Ascenty's data centre named Rio de Janeiro 1 located in Rio de Janeiro opened in 2017. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.

Red Admiral DC, a subsidiary of Tullamore-based Lumcloon Energy, is set to build a 250MW data center in Westmeath, Ireland.     Plans for the multi-billion-euro project were submitted to An Bord Pleanála in December 2024 and in July 2025 the company submitted a planning application to Westmeath County Council, which is currently awaiting a decision.     Developed in partnership with South Korea’s SK Ecoplant, the project will be Ireland’s first energy-independent data center, generating, storing, and managing its own energy on-site.     It will use a combination of 160MW Solid Oxide Fuel Cells, a 250MW Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), and a 184MW solar photovoltaic array to power the facility.

Across 2,509 sqm of data hall, Ascenty's data centre named Rio de Janeiro 2 located in Rio de Janeiro opened in 2019. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.
Centersquare's EWR2 offers 24.6 MW across 432,259 square feet of infrastructure.
Ascenty's data centre named Paulínia 1 located in Sao Paulo opened in 2019. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquire Ascenty.
Data centre estimated to have opened in 2009. The shell is owned by Mapletree and operated by ST Engineering.

Opened in 2000, Equinix's DC13 is located in the data centre capital of the US: Ashburn, VA. DC13 contains a data hall of 6,968 square metres with a 6.5 megawatt capacity. DC13 is located near Aligned Energy's Ashburn data centre.

Campus Data Navarra is a large-scale, multi-phase data centre development by VDR Group and Colliers located in Gazólaz, Navarre.     With a planned total capacity of 300 MW across 200,000 m² and four purpose-built buildings, the site is designed to support high-density computing workloads and attract AI, cloud, and telecom clients. The first phase, delivering 50 MW, is scheduled for 2027, with full build-out by 2029.     Positioned near the A-12 and A-15 motorways, the site offers excellent connectivity and proximity to key fibre routes linked to subsea cables in Bilbao and Barcelona.     The campus will connect to the grid via a new 220 kV link to the nearby Orkoien substation. Planning approval is anticipated by late 2025, supporting the site's accelerated delivery timeline thanks to pre-developed land.

Opened in 2011, SFR's Netcenter facility is located within a large compound on the southern half of Lyon, with its four generators in the shed nearby. The data centre is estimated to be 4MW of IT load. In 2023, SFR's data centre activities were re-established as part of UltraEdge, a new colocation provider owned by Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners after a sale of shares by Altice France.

In Oct 2006 Digital Realty acquired a warehouse in Arizona.     The data center is located within Arizona's State University Research Park.     The facility was redeveloped into a data center in 2007. It serves 3MW of IT Load.
Located in downtown Denver, CoreSite’s DE1 data center is mostly a carrier hotel, with CoreSite having bought the full building in 2025. The site offers 1MW across 10,763.9sqft of data hall space.

Atlas Edge´s Hamburg data centre is a former Colt data centre located in Hamburg in Germany. NorthC´s Datacube Muenchenstein is a former netrics facility located in Muenchenstein, Switzerland. L&T have a planned project in Bengaluru.

STT Singapore 1 is located in the east of Singapore, in the Defu Industrial Estate that is undergoing a redevelopment into a green and sustainable industrial park of tomorrow. Dhaka Colo opened their facility in 2014. The facility serves 110 racks.

The facility reportedly will offer co-location and wholesale leasing solutions to hyperscalers, enterprises, and other data center users.

Facility has 30MVA utility power supply and offers 1kW/sqm as standard with higher power densities supported.
TelemaxX's third facility went live in the late 2000s, offering clients colocation space.
In 2025, Diode Ventures submitted plans for the 515-Roxbury Technology Park in Charles City, Virginia.

Orbit Telekom's Isparta data centre went into service in late 2018, and offers retail colocation services to its clients.

The facility is PRORED's first and sole facility in Spain. Originally launched in 1997 and located in the Valencia Technology Park (offering connection to nearby R+D+i facilities of primary business and technological institutions), the data centre supports PRORED's colocation and network services.
DTS Vietnam data centre is in collaboration with PCCW.     The data centre opened in 2011 with 0.2MW.
In 2025, ResetData and Centuria Capital Group launched their Nvidia-powered AI Factory and Marketplace. The facility is expected to go live in Q2 2025

The Altamira Data Centre Campus is a €3.6 billion technological infrastructure project in Cantabria, Spain, developed by Stoneshield Capital and XDC Properties. These phases will further expand the data centre capacity and infrastructure. Operations are due to start in 2032.

STT MediaHub is located in the west of Singapore in the city's digital media hub, known as the One-North business park.     The MediaHub was jointly developed by ST Telemedia and StarHub. Menlo Equities acquired this site in 2015. In Q1 2024, they put through planning applications for a five-building, 1 million sqft data center campus that will have a two-phase development. They plan for the campus to offer 180MW of critical IT capacity from an onsite SRP substation by Q4 2026.

In March 2024, Latos Data Centres submitted a full planning application to the Cardiff Council for a data centre and battery energy storage development. The campus will spread across 50,400 square metres split into two facilities of eight floors each.

NTT announced Mumbai 8 with the facility expected to serve 24MW of IT load. The first phase went live in 2022.

The Tarndale data centre is located in Albany, a suburb of Auckland. Occupied by Plan B since 2010, the two-story building has a total floor area of 484 sqm and is on a 1147 sqm site. H5 Data Centers acquired the data center in 2025 and renamed Silicon Valley Data Centers. Previows it was part of Element Critical's Silicon Valley One facility in Sunnyvale, California. Chittagong DC is Dhakacolo 2nd facility which opened in 2017. The facility has a total of 0.2MW of IT Load.
Nxtra Data Ltd is a subsidary of Airtel otherwise known as Bharti Airtel in 2013. NXTRA data center is located in Adheri East inside Boomerang building.

At full build, the Thésée DataCenter campus will contain 6 data halls of between 1-3MW each. The first building TDC01, hosting 2 data halls, became operational in July 2021. The company's shareholders are Groupe IDEC Invest, Banque des Territoires, and Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, a public financial institution.

Commissioned in 2010, this facility is Fujitsu's sole data centre in Perth. It is located 15km away from Perth's CBD, and is housed in a two-storey building. Fujitsu have 1.5 years remaining on the lease with a five year extension option.

DCI Data Centers was granted consent to purchase land for this site in June 2021. Construction for the facility began soon after, with the facility officially opened in April 2023. The facility is located in north-west Auckland.

Menlo Equities' 600,742, 144MW data center. The facility's on-site, 300MW substation is expected to come online in Q2 2028.

Digital Realty's BRU3 data centre is located in Zaventem, north-east Brussels. This facility went live in Q2 2023 and is one of three owned by Digital Realty in Belgium.

Spark's data centre is located in central Hamilton.
Sify opened its Kolkata data centre in 2020. The facility serves under 1MW of IT load.

Fully separate from ERCOT, this 5GW project plans to combine wind, solar, batteries, and dual-fed gas turbines in a 100% 24/7 Green Energy undertaking. The project known as 'Data City' will be located on 50,000 acres near Laredo, TX but the definitive location has not been shared.     Built out in phases, the first 300MW and 1 million sqft of data center space is planned to go live in 2026.     The project is designed with the capability to host large AI workloads including DLC cooling, supporting NVIDIA's latest Blackwell and Rubin chip designs.

H5's San Jose data centre was acquired in 2014. The 6,781sqm building was retrofitted in 2000 by its former owner, Laird Technologies, and now boasts a 100% uptime record. The facility offers a number of options for tenants including private cages and suites and the potential for expansion.
DigiCo REIT has an option to expand its current lease with Brisbane Airport Corporation to include this site.

Located in close proximity to NRT10, the NRT campus consists 3 buildings of NRT12 (36MW), NRT14 (34MW), and NRT13 (14MW?). Purchase of the land began September 2019 and was completed in 2020.
