These facilities are part of the Tokyo Connected Campus @ Inzai development roadmap.

NTT's CA2 data center in Sacramento, California sits adjacent to the company's CA1 facility. CA2 was constructed by RagingWire in 2014 and became NTT data center when the two companies merged in 2019. CA2 offers 23,225 sqm of space and 26.1 MW of IT power.

JB1 is located in Bintaro and has been operational since 2007. The facility has a gross building area of 4876 sqm and a data hall size of 2121 sqm.

An undisclosed company bought a 114 acre plot in Floyd County for data center development in Q4 2024. In Q2 2025, it was later revealed Atlas Development plans for a 2.4 million sqft campus at this location. This campus will feature 7 buildings with build out continuing until the end of 2032.
CtrlS opened their Bengaluru data center in 2018. The facility provides up to 12 MW.

Announced in April 2024, STACK Infrastructure plans their next Dallas data center campus in Lancaster with 6 buildings totaling 288MW of critical IT capacity, with the potential for 500MW. Opened in 2017 and located in Auckland, Mt Eden is one of Chorus NZ's three EdgeCentre facilities.
Opened in 2019 and located in Christchurch, Avonhead is one of Chorus NZ's three EdgeCentre facilities (previously a telephone exchange building).

In September 2021, Proximity announced the acquisition of the former Capgemini Merlin Data Centre. Located in Swindon, the facility started operations in September 2010.     In Q3 2023, Proximity was acquired by nLighten.
AdaniConnex acquired land in Sector 62 to build a data center.     In Q2 2022, Ahluwalia Contracts secured the contract for constructing Sector 62 site.
Cyberjaya 4 is located within the NTT Data Center campus and has been operational since 2013. Cyberjaya 4 was later expanded with Cyberjaya 4 Annex in end 2017.

After acquiring the land next to Meta in the Mesa Elliot Technology Corridor, Edgecore opened their PH01 data center in 2019.     The campus is expected to have a total of 5 buildings with the capability of supporting over 450MW of Critical IT Load.

9333 Grand Avenue is one of three buildings in the 8.9ha Digital Chicago Campus, located in Franklin Park. The facility has a building size of 11,585 sqm and 6.8MW of IT load. The land was acquired in May 2012. Redevelopment of the building began in August 2012 and was completed in late 2013.
Located in Dubai Marina and operational since 2017, the building size is 3402 square meters with colocation space of 1500 square meters.

irix data centre is located in the Sarawak region with its own cable landing station and internet exchange. Pieni Paja data centre was built on YLE's media campus near the Iso Paja in 2023 - in close proximity with company's other facilities. Within the same area there is also FICIX - Finnish Communication and Internet Exchange.

Extendo Data Center's facility is located in the eastern French city of Belfort and first opened at the end of 2017. It is specifically located in the Techn'hom industrial site in the west of the city and is largely focused on servicing local enterprises and connectivity providers.

9377 Grand Avenue is one of three buildings in the 8.9ha Digital Chicago Campus, located in Franklin Park. The facility has a building size of 16,638 sqm and 12.8MW of IT load. Switch Datacenters began developing their 6th site in Amsterdam. The data centre in Schiphol is expected to deliver 45MW of IT Capacity once fully completed. The site will deliver green heat to greenhouses.

This facility went live in 2000 and has 500 sqm white space. The data centre houses smaller data halls (1-20 racks) and larger data halls (100 racks). Located north of Seville and originally launched in 2017 by Comvive, the company created the Sevilla Datacenter company in 2019 to operate the facility. The site benefits from close proximity to transport routes and national network infrastructures.

Community ISP's (CISP) offer a 3,911 sqm colocation data centre on a 2 hectre campus, located in Toledo, Ohio, United States.  The data centre opened in August 2000 after moving from Arrowhead Park.

Conscious Data Centers' facility in Rancho Cordova, California offers 4,645 square meters of data hall floor and 5 megawatts of IT power. The facility utilizes Orthogonal Cooling and has a dedicated substation for added reliability. The data center's location affords clients high-speed network connectivity while being outside of the earthquake and 2,000-year flood zones.

NTT´s Bangkok 2 data centre is located in the Amata Nakorn Industrial Estate and has a colocation space of 3800 sqm (1500 racks) within a gross area of 9600 sqm. The four-storey facility is the company's second data centre for Bangkok and has been operational since December 2015.     This facility was through the acquisition (June 2013) of Digital Port (established in 2012) prior to its opening.
Interxion first entered the Spanish market in 2000. Located in the Silicon Alley area, Interxion's campus is one of the most connected environments in Madrid.

ServerFarm's Moses Lake building initially served as a North American Air Defense Command Direction Center from 1958-1963. It housed an IBM S.A.G.E. computer system used to monitor and coordinate US air defense in the early years of the Cold War. The data center was leased to Cyxtera from 2015 to 2021. After Cyxtera's departure in June 2021, the facility's current status is unclear.

With rumours since Q1 2025, it was confirmed in September 2025 that Vantage plans to develop a data centre campus in Zaragoza. The 40-hectare site will be developed in collaboration with local company Desarrollos Ecoindustriales La Cartuja. Plans regarding design and timelines haven't been outlined but it is likely to consist of 4 buildings. The Governing Council has approved the declaration of regional interest but planning has not yet been given. So far 90MW of power has been procured from Endesa.
Garfield Heights 1 is Expedient's first data centre in Ohio and is located in Cleveland. It became operational in 2006 and has been built in multiple phases (February 2008 and January 2015).

Mar 2024, BW Digital and Citramas Group announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding for a joint development of a carrier-neutral digital ecosystem in Nongsa Digital Park.     This partnership follows BW Digital’s acquisition of more than 5.5 hectares of land at the Citramas-owned Nongsa Digital Park.     With a planned capacity of up to 80MW, the data centre will be designed to meet high density requirements. The exact location of the site is currently undisclosed.

Marunouchi Direct Access is a joint venture between Mitsubishi Estate and Marubeni Corporation. The company provides optical dark fibre network services and data centre services. Mitsubishi Estate owns numerous buildings in the area of Otemachi-Marunouchi- Yurakucho, and along with Marubeni Corporation, their optical fibre network serves 70% of buildings in this area. Opened in 2012, this facility has approximately 500 racks. The coordinates are unknown. In February 2022, Marunouchi Direct Access announced that all three data centres in Tokyo would be powered by renewable energy.

CMH1 is Cyxtera's data centre in Columbus, Ohio. The facility offers 2508 sqm of raised floor space and over 8MW of utility and generator power. CenturyLink used to operate this facility, and it was acquired by in May 2017 by a consortium led by BC Partners and Medina Capital (who formed a new company called Cyxtera Technologies).

CMC Telecom HCMC01 is located in Saigon Hi-Tech Park and opened in October 2012. The facility is 1.3MW and serves 300 racks in a 2,100 sqm building.     CMC Telecom also has a land bank adjacent to HCMC02 that is reserved for future developments.
AtlasEdge's expansion in Vienna will feature a second facility close to VIE001, expected to go into operation in late 2026.
LG U+ purchased the land and buildings from LG Display in May 2024 to be developed into a data centre campus by 2027.
SYD01 was acquired from Woolworths in 2016. It is located in the western area of Sydney. This is DCI's first facility in Sydney.
This facility will be located in Memphis, TN and consist of a 99,000 sqft data center that is hoping to become operational in 2025.
Equinix's 1st data centre in Tokyo opened in 2001. The facility has a 2,112 sqm of colocation space which houses 800 racks.
Garfield Heights 2 is Expedient's second data centre in Cleveland, OH. The facility is a 2310 sqm data centre that has offers 1160 sqm data hall space with 2MW of IT power.

Stargate UAE’s first 200MW phase, led by Abu Dhabi’s G42 with partners OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, Cisco, and SoftBank, launches in 2026. Part of a 1GW cluster within a 5GW AI campus, the facility will deliver advanced compute for AI workloads, powered by nuclear, solar, and natural gas.
Humain's Dammam data centre is set to go live in 2026, and will represent the first phase of a country-wide project to install substantial IT capacity for AI training.
AtlasEdge's Vienna expansion will feature the site in Southern Vienna, offering additional colocation services.
HTC´s Hoa Lac Green Data Center I is located at the Hoa Lac Hi-Tech Park in Hanoi, Vietnam. The facility is Uptime Tier 3 certified and has 150 racks operational since 2020.
Located in Huntingwood NSW and operational since September 2017, the campus sits on a land plot of 7.4 hectares.

Intergate.Seattle’s West Campus comprises three data center buildings and office space leased to multiple colocation providers and other internet-based businesses and institutions. It is also the headquarters of Sabey Data Centers.

Opened in September 2019, Zain's Bunker is located in the King Hussein Business Park in Amman.      The 4,300sqm data centre is 12m underground, includes a disaster recovery centre, and is built to be resistant to fire, earthquakes or missiles.

Klang Valley Data Center (KVDC) is part of TM One’s Twin Core Data Centre strategy- to link TM's core data centres in KL and Iskandar through a 100Gbps digital super highway and allow the data centers to be 'virtually side-by-side'. KVDC has two development phases and has dual 33 kV power feed from 2 independent utility power stations. It is speculated that the facility would be expanded upon significant take-up. It was reported in December 2021 that KVDC had an occupancy rate of more than 50% and has expansion plans in the pipeline.
Humain's Riyadh data centre is set to go live in 2026, and will represent the first phase of a country-wide project to install substantial IT capacity for AI training.

Located in Bet Shemesh, Israel, this site is one of three facilities being developed by Compass Data Centers in Israel. The company is partially owned (32.4%) by Israel’s real estate giant, Azraeli Group who also own 100% of data centre operator Green Mountain. In June 2023, it was announced that the that Brookfield Infrastructure Partners is to acquire Compass Datacenters . Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, already investors, will own part of the business. All three data centres are built-to-suit designs in order to accommodate for their hyperscale tenant.

In 2025, BlackChamber acquired the 38-acre site of the Merrifield Garden Center in Gainesville, which is set to close at the end of the year. Plans for the facility have not yet been announced, but the plot is in the county's data center opportunity zone overlay district, and would allow for by-right zoning.

Rack Centre´s LGS 1 data centre is located in the district of Oregun in Lagos, Nigeria. The Tier 3 facility has been operational since October 2013 and has already undergone two expansions for its facility. Rack Centre has completed its latest LGS 2 expansion in May 2025  an expansion.

December 2024, Global Data Centre entered an MOU with Maxland which company has entered into a lease agreement Kulim Technology Park Corporation for a 60-year lease of 4.6 acres of land in the Kulim Hi-Tech Park.

Announced in September 2025, this is the first data centre development in Gibraltar. The site will be powered off-grid and consists of a modular design providing 250MW of total IT capacity. Construction is planned to begin early 2026 with the first phase delivered end of 2027. The rest of the site will be developed in 4 additional phases with full build out planned for 2033.

First knowledge of this project came in Q3 2025 with tax breaks totalling €16.2m were announced by the Abrantes City Council. Planned development will occur in three phases with a maximum IT capacity of 800 MW. Operations are expected to begin in Q2 2028, with the first phase holding 300MW. This site is located in the Pego Industrial Park, with information on the exact location not yet released.

This facility was AQ Compute's first colocation data centre. It is now part of hscale's portfolio, who take operational control of the data centre having launched in Q2 2025.     The facility was originally scheduled to launch by the end of 2021 with an initial capacity of 5MW, but eventually went live in Q1 2024 with a 6MW deployment. In Q2 2024, its planned expansion to 14MW IT load was announced. The data centre focuses on servicing AI and HPC applications.     Hscale plans to expand this facility and two more nearby sites to a total of 200 MW IT load.

The Red Cedar site totals about 324 acres along County Highway B between 650th Avenue and 690th Avenue north of Interstate 94 and was annexed into Menomonie and rezoned to Restricted Industrial I 1 on August 4 2025 for a potential data center proposed by Balloonist LLC, which is represented locally by attorney Douglas S Buck of Quarles and Brady, with the City having approved a pre development agreement discussion in March 2025. The ultimate owner behind Balloonist nor a concrete timeline has not been publicly disclosed as of Q3 2025.

Located in Tnuvot, Israel, this site is one of three facilities being developed by Compass Data Centers in Israel. The company is partially owned (32.4%) by Israel’s real estate giant, Azraeli Group who also own 100% of data centre operator Green Mountain. In June 2023, it was announced that the that Brookfield Infrastructure Partners is to acquire Compass Datacenters . Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, already investors, will own part of the business. All three data centres are built-to-suit designs in order to accommodate for their hyperscale tenant.
Cyberjaya 3 is located within the NTT Data Center campus that is also home to the head office and other 5 data centres. Cyberjaya 3 has been operational since 2012.
Pennhurst Group LLC plans to convert the former Pennhurst state school and hospital site into a large-scale data center. But the plan is facing significant opposition from local residents.

365 Data Centers' Tampa facility is centrally located in the Franklin Exchange building, in the heart of downtown Tampa. It serves as the most important connectivity hub in Florida outside the NAP in Miami, and out of which 365 operates the Tampa Internet Exchange, a peering exchange which supports the cost effective exchange of Internet traffic.     It is also a prime building to serve wireless transmissions, with a direct line of site to a majority of financial, government, law enforcement and university facilities from its rooftop.     The Tampa facility is connected to the robust and stable TECO power grid that also feeds local hospital and government facilities.

The Sofia SO2 data center located at Bonchev Street in Sofia, Bulgaria offers a high level of national and international peering and connectivity. It is a secure and carrier-neutral environment with high-speed connections serving the EU, Turkey and the Caucasus.
Viettel IDC open their facility in the Da Nang area in 2014 with 0.5MW of IT load.
The Adam PTV data centre is located in The Vallés Technology Park in the North of the Metropolitan Barcelona area. In operation since 2013, it supports 4MW of IT load across 3,400 sqm of data hall.

Datacate's data center in Rancho Cordova, California was built in 1999 by Datacate's sister company Technicate. The company began offering colocation services in 2008. The 1,114 square meter facility offers 464 sqm of data hall space and 1.4 MW of incoming power. Datacate also has 278 sqm phased for the future data hall floor.
Iron Mountain acquired the land for its VA8/9 project in late 2021. The land received rezoning approval in July 2025 and is expected to come online in Q1 2027 with 28MW.
The Equinix SO1 data center located in Sofia, Bulgaria is a resilient, secure and carrier-neutral environment with high speed connections ready to serve the EU, Turkey and the Caucasus. ﻿

China Western Information Centre went live in 2011 and is host to data centers such as ZenLayer. It also functions as an information security centre for communication exchange and information processing in Western China.

Databank's (ORD2) Downtown Chicago Metro Data Center went live in October of 2016. The facility offers 929 sqm raised-floor space and an IT capacity of 2MW. The facility was first opened by Zayo in October 2016 and was bought (along with other Zayo data centres) by DataBank in December 2020.
Located in Slough, CyrusOne London III supports 9MW of IT load across 3600 sqm of space
CyrusOne´s Frankfurt III data centre is located in Sossenheim in Frankfurt in Germany. The facilities have been in operation since 2021.
Originally meant to be RFS in 2022, the opening of Chindata Group's 2nd facility (CE02) has been delayed.
In September 2025, an application was filed for a 1GW campus along Mamre Road.

Vantage campus in Poland will be sited on more than 5 ha land plot located 30 minutes drive from Warsaw-Chopin International Airport and 1km away from Mlociny underground. Once fully developed, the campus will comprise of 2, four-storey buildings with combined capacity of 48MW.
Simplex's first data centre in Cyprus went live in 2007, offering clients retail colocation services.
Princeton Digital Group has completed building the Shanghai Campus. The campus went live in 2020 with a total three buildings with 42MW IT Load.

Equinix´s HE4 data centre is a former Telecity data centre which it acquired from Tenue Oy. Facility was previously called Hansa. Data centre is located in Vantaa. Equinix leased the facility from Finnish family office TS-Yhtymä, but in June 2022, Hyperco announced acquisition of the data centre for over 35 million euros. The new owner has plans to expand the facility as site could support 10-20MW data centre.

365's data center in Rancho Cordova, California was built in 1983 as an MCI Worldcom facility. In 2006, MCI and its facilities were acquired by Verizon. The building at 11085 Sun Center Drive has changed hands several times since the freehold was acquired by Digital Realty in 2001, by Carter Validus in 2018, and finally by Mapletree in Q2 2021. However, Sungard operated the facility from 2010 to 2022, when 365 purchased Sungard's colocation portfolio. The 6,414 sqm building offers 2,597 sqm of data hall space and 2.7 Megawatts of IT power.

On 1st June 2025, CMC Corporation began building its $300-million CMC Creative Space Hanoi in the Tây Hồ Tây urban area. Scheduled for operation in Q4 2027, Creative Space Hanoi will be a tech hub combining R&D labs, AI and cloud computing facilities, and startup incubation with a five-storey international-standard data centre.

Quest Technology's Services is located in McClellan Business Park. The facility was built to store data for companies in the event of a natural disaster and was built in a seismically stable area well above the flood plain.

Evocative's data center in Santa Clara, California, is a 2,787-square-meter building with 1.5 MW of IT load. The facility was initially opened as a Layer42 data center and acquired by Wave Business as a business continuity facility in 2015. Evocative acquired the facility in late 2022 from VPLS, which purchased the building in November 2021.
Management Science Associates' data center in Tarentum, Pennsylvania, offers 41,979 sq ft of infrastructure and 19,999 sq ft of raised floor.
NTT held the groundbreaking ceremony for Osaka North 1 in October 2025. The first building of the campus is scheduled for completion in early 2028.
Construction on this site started in September 2021 and readied for service November 2021. EC5 Albury's IT load is 0.15MW. 100% of the power is provided by solar energy.

Located at 4km from Via Caldera, Avalon 3's 3.2MW utilizes renewable energy and can fit 500 racks within a gross building area of 3500 sqm. Irideos’ shareholder Marguerite’s stake were acquired by Asterion in July 2022, with Marguerite having reinvested them into Asterion’s holding company Marbles S.p.a. Marbles S.p.a. also now currently fully owns Retelit (data centre and fibre infrastructure provider), which is expected to merge with Irideos in the next year.

In April 2022, Open DC, telcom-hub data center operator formed a strategic alliance with Northern Gateway Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Minister of Finance. They acquired land at the Delapan Special Border Economic Zone (formerly known as Kota Perdana Special Border Economic Zone), a high-tech park at Bukit Kayu Hitam, the border town between Thailand and Malaysia, to develop a Tier-3 data center by 2024. An IX point will also be set up in this data centre to facilitate the traffic exchange in this region. The exact location of the land site is currently undisclosed.
Cloudlayer8's data centre went live in early 2019, offering retail colocation services.
This is the second EdgeConneX site in the Atlanta area, located in the northern part of the city, featuring a 10 MW capacity and enabling local cloud on-ramp connections.

The 102, 500 sqft data center will be located in the Trinity Hills area in Nashville on a 12 acre site. The IT load will be 12MW and be completed in 2026. The facility is designed for high-density compute and scale network applications.
Facility is estimated to have opened in early 2000s. Initially run by MarquisNet, acquired by zColo in 2012. In 2020, DataBank acquired zColo from Zayo.

Keppel DC Singapore 5 (KDC SGP 5) is located in Jurong, Singapore. The facility is a five-storey, purpose-built, carrier-neutral colocation data centre hosting leading internet enterprise and IT services clients. It features approximately 98,769 sq ft of net lettable area and was acquired from Kingsland Development in 2018. The data centre first began operations in 2015.

Africa Data Centres Sameer Data Center is located at Sameer Industrial Park in Nairobi. The data centre is the company's first data centre in Nairobi. ADC announced in June 2022 an expansion to add more IT capacity for its data centre.
Wave's facility in Mountain View, California was originally a Layer 42 facility. The latter company was fully acquired by Wave in 2015. The facility is 4,000 square meters.

Cologix opened up their DAL2 data center in Dallas, TX early 2013. At just over 11,800sqft the facility offers 2MVA and a total IT Capacity of 1.5MW. The building offers access to their other two sites, DAL1 and DAL3.

ClusterPower´s Mischii Campus is located in the southern part of Craiova in Mischii, Romania. Sitting on a 2,5-hectare plot and the new campus will have 5 buildings in total once fully developed. The first phase with its first building has been put in operation in April 2022. The project is set to be completed in 2025.

Atlas Development planned a data center campus in Newnan, Georgia. This campus will be on a 769 acre plot and will have 13 buildings that are roughly 378,000 sqft for a total of 4.9 million sqft. This project has been put on hold as Coweta County put a 180 day moratorium on data centers. Prologis has also decided to buy this site from Atlas Development for future data center development.
Located at 133 Liverpool Sydney, SYCS1 has been operational since February 2011 and was acquired from Pacnet in 2014.

Bulk's N01 Campus is located in Vennesla (Kristiansand), Norway and has been in operation since 2018.     The campus currently has three live buildings for various customer deployments, with significant pipeline expansion.     In 2022, Bulk secured land ownership by declaring to buy ca. 80ha land adjacent to their already owned land. They now own 300 hectares of land, near to one of Europe's largest transformer stations. 125MVA power is already available near on campus. Bulk Data Centers is exploring potential to create a circular industry cluster that could benefit from energy re-use.

EngineNode's first data centre scheme is located in-between Gunnocks and Bracetown, immediately to the West of Facebook's Clonee campus in County Meath.     Planning was initially submitted in 2019 for a campus comprising four data centres and one energy centre set over a 25 hectare (60 acre) site, and conditional consent was granted in June 2020.     Since then the site has faced numerous appeals with An Bord Pleanala granting planning permission on the 05/07/2021. Moreover, in July 2023, the High Court dismissed another appeal against the development.     Each of the four buildings comprises c.23,000 sqm of developable area over two floors and support up to 18MW IT load for a total of 72MW across the campus

Quest's High Availability Business Centre in Roseville, California is a data centre and a leasable office space. The 11,450 sqm facility was built to store data for companies in the event of a natural disaster and was built in a seismically stable area well above the flood plain.
A golf course in Dauphin County is being sold for $45.6 million to Harrisburg I, LLC, a purchasing entity under Provident Realty. The 250-acre property will be transformed into a data center.

In 2013, Cogego and Peer 1 opened a 5,574sqm, single-tenant data centre in Barrie, Ontario. The facility expanded in 2015, adding 1,858 sqm of data hall floor. The 2,830 sqm of white space is spread across three data halls.     In 2019, Cogeco and Peer 1 rebranded as Aptum Technologies, and in 2021 eStruxture acquired Aptum's Canadian colocation facilities.

Energy Capital Partners, through its subsidiary Calpine Corporation, is developing a data center project in Pennsylvania. The facility is being built on the site of Calpine’s 828 MW York 2 Energy Center in Peach Bottom Township, York County. The project is estimated to be worth $5bn.

Located in north-east Paris, this development aims to convert an industrial site into a data centre.      75MVA was secured from RTE in April 2023 with delivery set for Q3 2028.      Building permits were applied for in Q1 2024 but are not yet obtained with a public inquiry currently underway until 7 November 2025.      Current timelines aim to start construction of the facility in Q1 2027 with a planned RFS of Q3 2028.

NorthC´s Data center Almere is located on the Sallandsekant business park, in Almere, east of Amsterdam.      The facility was previously owned by local landline and telecommunications company KPN under the subsidiary NLDC which was sold to DWS in 2019. DWS then formed NorthC in 2020 after merging NLDC & The Datacenter Group (TDCG).
PDC Realty LLC, tied to local developer Jim Marzolino, purchased the 83.5-acre Highway Auto Parts junkyard in Archbald to build the proposed data center. Plans call for three two-story data centers.

This facility was opened by Sentinel Data Centers in 2013 with an initial phase of 8MW. CyrusOne acquired the facility in February 2017 and have since expanded the capacity to 22 MW, with 13.3 MW of capacity currently available for lease. Upon full build out, the facility could be capable of supporting a total of 46 MW of colocation IT load, currently planned to be live by Q4 2027, provided approval is granted.

Operational since October 2018, this is Digital Realty's second data centre in Sydney. It is located in within Digital Realty's campus in West Sydney, neighbouring the company's first facility in Sydney. The facility is a two-storey building.
This facility was operationalised in 2017.

In 2025, Machine Investment acquired two former LSC Communications facilities in Lancaster, PA with plans to convert them for AI and hyperscale data center use. 1375 Harrisburg Pike offers 825,000 square feet for infrastructure. Machine Investment announced a partnership with Chirisa Technology Parks and CoreWeave. Chirisa reports that it will build two campuses in Lancaster, PA. Each campus is expected to house one 450,000sqft building with 130MW utility and one 750,000 building with 220MW utility.

Equinix's CU3 data centre is one of four facilities on Equinix's Culpeper, VA campus. The facility was built By Terremark in 2011 for Verizon. Finally, Equinix acquired Verizon's data centre portfolio in 2017.

An extension to the Avalon Campus (located at Settimo Milanese within 3 km of the campus), Avalon 2 hosts colocation service in 300 sqm of data halls. Irideos’ shareholder Marguerite’s stake were acquired by Asterion in July 2022, with Marguerite having reinvested them into Asterion’s holding company Marbles S.p.a. Marbles S.p.a. also now currently fully owns Retelit (data centre and fibre infrastructure provider), which is expected to merged with Irideos.

Adjacent to DC Sydney 1, Gore Hill Data Centre has been operational since 2012. Daily operations are handled by iSeek-KDC Services, which is a 60:40 JV between Keppel Data Centres and iSeek. This site is also home to the Australian Liquidity Centre.

In 2025, Machine Investment acquired two former LSC Communications facilities in Lancaster, PA with plans to convert them for AI and hyperscale data center use.  Machine Investment announced a partnership with Chirisa Technology Parks and CoreWeave. Chirisa reports that it will build two campuses in Lancaster, PA. Each campus is expected to house  one 450,000sqft building with 130MW utility and one 750,000 building with 220MW utility.

A new data center campus near Kearneysville, West Virginia, will use a 90-acre parcel for two buildings, an electrical switching station, and a water tank, with access to a natural gas pipeline and dual high-capacity transmission lines.

The Western Sydney facility underwent an expansion to add 4500sqm of colocation space in 2020. The Australian Securities and Investment Commission's uses this facility as its primary data centre - it's second is with CDC at Eastern Creek.
Opened in 1999, Equinix's DC7 is located in Vienna VA. DC7 contains a data hall of 2,541 square metres with a 3.8 megawatt capacity.

Equinix's CU4 data centre was constructed in 2015 by Terremark for Verizon. The facility offers 2,632 sqm of data hall floor and was acquired by Equinix when the company purchased Verizon's data centre portfolio in 2017.

A former Colt data centre, this facility has been live since 1998 and has a colocation space of 1600 sqm and 3 MVA. The facility changed ownership in Q4 2021 and is part of Atlas Edge´s acquisition of twelve Colt´s data centres across Europe.

Opened in 2010, Equinix's DC6 is located in the data centre capital of the US: Ashburn, VA. DC6 contains a data hall of 5,516 square metres with a 7.5 megawatt capacity. DC6 is situated in a cluster with five other Equinix data centres.

Digital Realty's data centre in Charlotte, North Carolina was originally opened in 2000 by Pinnacle Telecom. Digital Realty acquired Pinnacle's Charlotte data centres in 2005. The facility offers 2,712 sqm of total infrastructure space and 2.5 MW of critical load.

Operational since December 2020, the Fuchu Data Center has a gross floor area of 45,419 sqm with approximately 4000 racks and an IT load of 35MW (a collaboration with IDC Frontier). This facility was acquired in 2020 by Hulic, a real estate company that focuses largely on developing and managing office and commercial spaces.

Located in the former Tessiture di Nosate headquarters and factory, this facility underwent an upgrade between November 2021 and December 2022 on 5 hectares of land as part of an arrangement for the National Strategic Pole/Italian Public Administration's data to be hosted. This facility is also part of the 6 data centres to have been refurbished/built from the TIM/Noovle agreement: three in Turin (Rivoli, Settimo Torinese, and Moncalieri) and 3 in Milan (Rozzano, Cassina Pecchi, and Stefano Tichino).

Opened in 2016, Equinix's DC12 is located in the data centre capital of the US: Ashburn, VA. DC12 contains a data hall of 5,370 square metres with a 9 megawatt capacity. DC12 is situated next to Equinix's DC15 data centre.
SoftBank started construction on a data centre in Ikoma, Nara, in 2023 and the topping out ceremony was hosted in July 2025. The facility is scheduled to enter operations in October 2025.
The data centre is located in Santa Lucia di Piave, north of  Treviso. It is spread over 50 m2 of IT space and offers less than 1 MW IT capacity.

Prometheus Hyperscale, formerly Wyoming Hyperscale, are developing a four-building campus. This campus will provide 1.2GW of power, up from the initially anticipated 120MW. The campus will be powered by solar, wind, natural gas, and eventually nuclear provided by Oklo. It aims to be fully sustainable by  recycling its water, using efficient liquid cooling systems, and providing waste heat to greenhouses and a shrimp farm. The first phase is already underway and expected to come online in mid-2026.

Equinix's CU1 data centre in Culpeper, Virginia is the first of four on the campus. CU1 was opened by Terremark in 2008 and became a Verizon data centre when the telecommunications company acquired Terremark in early 2011. Finally, Equinix acquired Verizon's data centre portfolio in 2017.
The ProxiCenter is located on avenue du domaine de Vialle, in Bouliac, 8 km from the center of Bordeaux and from Saint-Jean train station, and 22 km from Mérignac airport.

Opened in 2012, Equinix's DC11 is located in the data centre capital of the US: Ashburn, VA. DC11 contains a data hall of 10,854 square metres with a 16 megawatt capacity. DC11 is located next to InfoRelay IAD1.

Eastern Creek Campus contains most of CDC's footprint in Sydney. It is a campus that has four live facilities - EC1, EC2 and EC3, with the latest EC4 facility that was ready for service in the second half of 2022. Two more facilities - EC5 and EC6 are currently in development. The facility opened in 2011 and was acquired in December 2018 from DXC Technology (founded 2017 through Hewlett-Packard spin off of its Enterprise Services and merger with Computer Sciences Corporation). The Australian Securities and Investment Commission's uses this facility as its secondary data centre - it's primary with Fujitsu in Western Sydney.
43881 Devin Shafron Drive (Bldg B) is located in Ashburn, VA. This single storey building is 16,723 sqm, on 3.04 hectares of land, and has 9 MW of IT load.
This campus is located at Port Park, Melbourne. It is Interactive's sole facility in Melbourne. In 2011, it was announced that the facility underwent an expansion.

The Szlachecka Data Processing Centre consists of Szlachecka A and Szlachecka B. The first building launched in 2011 and holds 1300 m2 of IT space. The second facility was built adjacent to the first. It launched in 2021 and holds 1700 m2 of IT space.
Digital Realty's data centre at 44520 Hastings Drive was opened in 2006.

Echelon will be developing a two-building campus consisting of 122 MW of IT capacity in Treviglio, east of Milan. The site has electrical capacity of 250MVA gross power, 100MVA of which is available immediately through the existing onsite substation.

S3 is NEXTDC's third facility in Sydney. Development Approvals for this project were granted in December 2019. Multiplex was involved in the construction of the facility. The official opening of the facility took place in September 2022, with construction on the second phase having completed in June 2023.

Atman Data Center Warsaw-1 (WAW-1) is part of the largest in Poland Atman telecommunications campus. The company head office is also located here. The company has freehold on land and buildings. Fully built out campus has potential to serve up to 25MW of IT. The F6 building launched at the end of September 2021. Building F7 was announced in August 2022. The building launched in Q1 2024.

Equinix´s HE3 data centre is a former Telecity data centre located in Helsinki in Finland. The facility is the companies second of six data centres in Helsinki and has been in operation since 2010. Telecity acquired this facility from Tenue Oy. At that time, the facility was the most connected data centre in Helsinki.

Fortress's data center in San Francisco, California was opened in 2015. The historic building at 274 Brannan has been retrofit to better withstand seismic events. The facility has an advantageous proximity to AT&T's San Francisco fiber networks and offers Edge and 5G.

Nxtra data center intend to build their 3rd site in Pune of 40MW IT Load.     They have proposed of a site located in the Hinjewadi Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park.     Construction is expected to start in Q1 2023.     The site is located close to their Pune 1.
This facility was formerly under Japan Telecom and Vodafone. The five-storey building spans 20,472sqm and opened in 2008.

Vantage Data Centers JNB1 Campus is located in Johannesburg’s Waterfall City in South Africa. The new campus is the company's first development in Africa and South Africa and will consist of three buildings when fully developed. Phase 1, with its first building has went live in July 2022.

GTS Telecom´s DC4 Data Center is located inside the Liberty Technology Park in Cluj-Napoca in Romania. The facility is the companies second data centre is the location in Romania and has been put in operation since 2016 and completed another expansion in 2018 to its full capacity.

PowerTransitions is exploring converting a decommissioned power plant and water treatment installation in Kansas City, Kansas into 2 data center buildings. The former fossil-fueled power plant sits on an 85 acre site, and initial plans are for an eventual 192 MW campus.

Formerly known as Thinx Poland DC. Facility was renovated in 2020 - added additional 600 sqm data hall. One data hall was commissioned in December 2020, the other 2 in January 2021. CloudHQ´s Frankfurt campus is located in Offenbach, Germany. The campus consists of two data centre buildings and has completed the shell of the buildings. Phase 1 of the campus went live in 2023. However, construction is still going on with more phases being added to the campuses.

The Telepark facility in Belgrade is owned by SBB, one of Serbia's leading telecommunications companies. The facility is located in SBB's headquarters and is a carrier netural data centre. It is built according to TIER 3 standards and spread over 750 m2 IT space.
DayOne acquired Site 2 within Nusajaya Tech Park in Q4 2022 and has plans for a 26MW data center over 2 data center buildings.

In 2021, SKYY Development began construction on a data centre campus in Kashiwa City of Chiba Prefecture. The first building was completed in late 2022. Upon full buildout, all buildings will cover over 72,000sqm.

The State Data Centre is located in Kragujevac, Serbia and is owned by Data Cloud Technology, a company founded by the Serbian Government for the purposes of maintaining the data centre. It was opened in 2021 and built according to TIER 4 standards. The facility is spread across 14000 m2 and holds 1080 racks capacity. It's tenants include both the public and private sector.
NTT's planned VA9 data centre will be located on the company's Gigabit Plaza campus.
H5's Buffalo I data center was originally opened by Yahoo. Yahoo opened its Lockport, New York, data center in 2010. The facility has a total of 191,995 sq ft of space.

The Yettel data centre was built in 2010 by Telenor and went live in 2011. The facility was acquired by Yettel, a regional telecommunications company in 2022.  It is located in Belgrade, Serbia and is spread over 2600 m2.

Located next to their Westin building in downtown Seattle. This facility is the result of a joint venture between Clise Properties, Inc. and Digital Realty. It is operated by Digital Realty and was built in 2013. Equinix has leased space in this facility where they operate their SE3 data center.

D-ALiX (formerly the neutral access point of Western Africa and Canary Islands S.A.) is situated in the Instituto Tecnológico y de Energías Renovables (Technological Institute and of Renewable Energies, commonly abbreviated as ITER) premises in the island of Tenerife. The D-ALiX site consists of infrastructure aimed at IT colocation services whilst operating within a highly renewable capacity.

The site is located a few kilometres away from the subsea cable landing points of MAREA and Google's Grace Hopper and acts as a cable landing station, providing a link between the company's sites on the eastern seaboard of the US and those in Europe.

NTT's VA4 data centre is one of seven data centres NTT plans to build on its massive 31.5-hectare plot in the renowned "Data Centre Alley." VA4 and VA5 are nearly identical in design; both will offer 32 MW of IT power across their four respective data floors.
In 2016, Globalinx acquired 4.6 hectares of land in Virginia Beach. Its 999 square metre meet-me-room is live, and an additional 13,935 square metres of data centre space is planned for expansion.

LF15 is the first building in the Xianghe campus. The 0.65ha plot of land has sufficient development potential to build data centres with up to 30,000sqm of data hall space. LF15 was ready for service in the second half of 2023.

DP Facilities' data centre in Wise, Virginia was opened in 2017. The 6,038 square metre facility can be expanded to offer up to 45 megawatts, and there is space on the 9-hectare plot to build an additional 18,580 sqm of data centre and office space.
Pacific Controls reportedly entered into liquidation in 2017. The facility is managed in partnership with Etisalat.

In 2020, Digital Realty announced plans for a massive data centre campus near Dulles International Airport. Plans for the campus include up to eleven data centres across 171 hectares of land. Each building could deliver between 96 and 144 megawatts. Digital Realty plans to build out the campus over a fifteen year time period.
By the end of Q1 2023, KIO Networks acquired BOG1 data centre in Bogota, Colombia. It is a 6 MW data centre with 2 data halls of 2000 sqm each, It is located in the Zona Franca complex.
Located in Dubai Silicon Oasis, these two facilities are designed to match the TIER III requirements. The data centres are both Carrier Neutral and provide retail colocation space.

Cloud Carrier leverages cutting-edge liquid cooling technology to achieve high levels of sustainability. Works on this site commenced in April 2023 with a first phase expected in 2024. The campus is located in the Southern Highlands of New South Wales. Data Building One (DB1), is the first in a series of liquid-cooled data centres in the campus.

725 South Wells is a 5MVA facility with 1.5MW of critical power. The 9-storey, 66,000 sf building has 42,000 sf of data centre space and 18,000 sf of ancillary/support/office space. Equinix are developing a facility in Dubai Production City. Their data centre is located next to their DX1 building. Equinix's DX3 became operational in Q3 2023.
Eur Tel's RM/A data centre (3500 sqm) is located at the Arte Antica palace, with RM/B (4500 sqm) at the Palazzo dei Congressi.
Network company Northland Communications maintains two colocation data centers in New York.

The T-Mobile facility in Krakow was built in 2005 and originally used as a self-built site for T-Mobile's commercial needs. In 2017, the facility was converted into a retail colocation site. The data centre is spread over 1800 m2 and offers 400 m2 IT space.
Sitco Business Solutions maintains a data centre presence in Evansville, Indiana.
This facility was formerly MC-Link and became part of Irideos' portfolio of data centres in early 2018. It is located in the town of  Trento, northern Italy and has been operational since 2000.
Located in South Subahiya, Zain operate a colocation data centre. This facility went live in 2004 and is in expansion since Q4 2022.
Iron Mountain plans to add to its Virginia campus with VA-3. VA-3 will have 44 megawatts which will be delivered in two phases, the first of which is set to go live in late 2023.

KIO Networks' data centre named Mex | 1 located in Mexico City opened in 2002 with 2.8MW of IT load and a 1.7 PUE.  In August 2021, I Squared Capital announced the acquisition of KIO through its ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund III and ISQ Growth Markets Infrastructure Fund.

Digital Park Fechenheim is located 1 km away from its Hanauer Landstraße campus in Frankfurt. The company has plans to build 11 data centres when fully built out by as early as 2028. Injazat's Abu Dhabi facility was initially announced in 2006. The building went under construction in 2008 and was completed in 2009. The data centre section of the facility spreads across 6,600 square meters with 2,000 square meters of data hall space.

The facility is now 100% leased. It is unclear whether Mapletree or another organization operates the facility.

As part of their effort to make Saudi Arabia a Digital Hub, STC founded in 2022 Center3. The company is developing data centres all over the Kingdom with this facility being located in the North East of Riyadh.

Located near KIZAD, Khazna are developing  a seven building campus. The data centres have received multiple Uptime certifications for design and facility.

UnitedHealth Group  have been operating the 22,300 sqm data centre at 14100 Business Center Drive since 2007. In January 2023, it was announced that they had sold the data centre to CloudHQ for $90 million.

Vantage's 16-hectare plot in Ashburn, VA will house six planned data centres. The campus can offer up to 206 MW on full build.

Located to the northwest of Hasselt, this facility was completed in 2010. In May 2023, Datacenter Hasselt, who operated this facility and another in Hasselt, sold both of their data centres to Datacenter United.

Located to the west of Hasselt, this facility was completed in 2009. In May 2023, Datacenter Hasselt, who operated this facility and another in Hasselt, sold both of their data centres to Datacenter United.
One of BMIT's two sites in Malta, the facility was fully acquired by the company in 2020 and offers 2MW of IT load across over 4,200sqm of data hall space.
The Sofia Center facility is located in the Sofia City centre. It offers up to 10 MW of IT power.

Founded in 2019 and located within Melita's head office, this facility is Melita's secondary facility in Malta and is connected to their Madilena site and offers colocation services to retail operators. Across 37.2 ha of land located in Santiago, the first Edgeconnex's data centre was named SCL01. It is a 7MW IT load complex in a 2600 sqm data hall facility.

The Cluj Napoca Orange facility is located in the southern part of Cluj Napoca, Romania. The facility most likely launched in 2009. It complies with TIA-942 - Tier 3 standard. The Bucharest Orange facility is located in the north-western part of Bucharest, Romania. It most likely launched at the beginning of 2009. It is up to TIA 942 Rated 3 standard and holds ISO27001 certification.

Launched in March 2012, the facility is situated in the west of Marseille where it is connected to several subsea cables which land in the city. In 2021, Jaguar Network and KDDI Telehouse launched a partnership, where Telehouse's first Marseille site (THM1) is to be located in the facility.
Triara's data centres are owned by Telmex (Carlos Slim's company). Triara Queretaro is one of the biggest data centre of the company. It has an 8400 sqm data hall.
Triara's data centres are owned by Telmex (Carlos Slim's company). Triara Monterrey is the second biggest data centre of the company. It has an 1361 sqm data hall.

Triara's data centres are owned by Telmex (Carlos Slim's company). Triara CDMX is a data centre located in Mexico City. It has a 400 sqm data hall.
CPH1 data centre is located in Ballerup, Denmark. The facility has been operational since 2000 with a total building area of 8,000 sqm.

Elm Data's data center in Buffalo, New York, was opened in 2010 and offers 1.2 MW of critical load.
This facility was launched in 2022 with 6MW of IT load and 2200 sqm data hall space.
Located next to the University of Vigo in Galicia,  Altia's facility hosts 0.6MW of IT load across 1,250sqm of data hall space.

Strategically located on major fiber routes and multiple power grids, 1100 Space Park Drive in Santa Clara provides access to dozens of the leading domestic and international carriers, as well as to physical connection points for the world's leading cloud and content providers. September 2023, K2 forged an Electricity Supply Agreement of 300MW power capacity from TNB for its JHR1 data centre in Johor.

Nation Data Center's Normandy site is their second facility in France, which was originally built for the French bank, BNP Paribas. The GlobalConnect GC Copenhagen data center has been operational since 2012.
Based close to the company headquarters on the island, this is Civicos Networking's primary data centre. The site hosts 0.2MW of IT load across 125sqm of data hall space.

Centrilogic's Buffalo, New York facility was opened in 2009. The data center offers managed services, disaster recovery, and colocation services.
Opened in 2021, this facility is equipped with 80 racks within 350 sqm of data hall space.

Located in close proximity to their main facility, the site is on the smaller scale and is located within a larger mixed-enterprise building with DC and non-DC operators within. Their facility specifically contains 60 racks within 250 sqm and an IT load of 0.25MW.
Opened in 2023, this facility is dc2scale's second facility in Velizy and third in France. The site is equipped with 200 racks within 600 sqm of IT space.

Opened in 2009 and located next to the University of Castilla-La Mancha, the Area Project Data Center provides retail colocation services, risk management and IT maintenance services throughout the region of Castilla-La Mancha from the site. Digital Realty's facility in Santa Clara, California was opened in 2015. The 3,491 square meter data center shares a building with Vantage's CA11 and offers 5.7 MW of IT load.

DataBank's NYC2 facility in New York, New York is located in The Google Building carrier hotel, which also houses several other data centres including Digital Realty and Equinix.  NYC2's suite offers 0.68 MW of power. The suite was acquired from Zayo in the latter half of 2020.
Rai Way's Siziano campus will comprise a 400kw facility and an adjacent 4MW facility. The 400kw went live in 2024.

DC  Paljetkova is situated in the APIS IT headquarters in Zagreb, Croatia. The facility launched in 1987 and was reconstructed in 2021. The IT space spreads over 560 m2 and holds 400 kW IT capacity. The main tenants of this facility are the Croatian state institutions and companies owned by the Croatian state.
Across an 18.9 ha plot a former Nabiax data centre, Actis' data centre named Ixtlahuaca located in the State of Mexico was acquired in 2023 with a 2.2MW IT load.
VDC1's data centre is 2609 sq ft and has two data suites with 600kVA power supply.
Bangkrak data center is located in CAT Tower on Charoen Krung Road.
Epsilon's data center suite in the 60 Hudson carrier hotel was originally opened in 1977 by Metcom. Epsilon acquired the 7997.59-sq ft space in early 2017.

365 Data Centers' Detroit is a 1,100 sqm facility with 800 sqm of raised floor space. In  late 2021,  the facility was sold to an unnamed institutional real estate investor.
ClearBearing is a managed services company which maintains a colocation facility in Essex Junction, Vermont. The company was founded in 1999.

Vantage's second site located in Glattfelden became operational in Q3 2024. Their first campus is located East of Zurich in Winterthur. ZRH21 will spread across 25,000 square metres and offer space for hyperscaler tenants.

Tierpoint's HWT data centre in Hawthorne, New York was opened by XAND in 2001. The facility was expanded in 2011 and acquired by Tierpoint in 2014. The 4,273 sqm data centre offers 2,601 sqm of data hall floor.
ManagedWay have two facilities in Michigan, with the other located nearby at 600 Executive Dr.

This facility is by Exaion, an EDF subsidiary, in partnership with Sherbrooke University.

Opened alongside American Tower's Boulder edge data center facility in Q3 2020, the sites were constructed due to growing demand for stronger cloud and network connection in the area.

This facility is located in Townsville, Queensland. It is a project developed with funding by the Townsville City Council and the joint Commonwealth-State Natural Disaster Resilience Program. It was ready for service in late 2019.

EdgeConneX has secured its second site in Phoenix.  Once fully complete, it's expected that the site will serve up to 100MW. They began construction late 2024 and had planned to begin operations in the first half of 2025; however, the site is still not complete.

As of Q4 2025, site grading, foundation work, and structural framing are underway for the first three buildings along with construction of an on-site ComEd transmission substation. T5 has secured 1.5 GW of transmission access through ComEd to support current and future phases. Initial energization of the substation and first building batch is scheduled for mid-2027, with subsequent phases to follow based on tenant demand.

With Corona, the tenant feared vacancies and cancelled, whereupon van Caem also said goodbye to the offices and company Prea suggested building a data centre as an alternative for that location. The data centre campus will consist of 4 total buildings each with 4 storeys.

The facility serves businesses looking for network connectivity and colocation services in the region.

Hana Asset Trust received a construction permit for a data centre in Ansan in May 2023. Digital Realty's data centre in Manassas, Virginia will be located on the plot of the former Glen-Gary brick yard, which began demolition in early 2023.

Construction is planned to start in 2025 and the operation of the data centre in 2027.

Designed by AO Architects the building is planned to go live in Q2 2025.

NXDATA is currently working on their third site in Bucharest. Estimated launch period: 2026.

EdgeConneX are planning a third data center near Portland. The facility will provide wholesale colocation space for their tenants. The building is yet to go under construction and should become operational in Q4 2024.

In Jun 2024, Actis announced the launch of Asia data centre platform Epoch Digital. The platform's first project is to be a data centre in Taipei, Taiwan.

A press release in September 2022 reveals that Digital Realty has filed to build a new data centre in Chicago, opposite its carrier hotel at 350 E Cermak Rd. The African Data Centres CPT2 data centre is in Cape Town. The new and second data centre facility in Cape Town increases the company´s data centres in South Africa to four. It is part of the investment programme to deliver an additional 10 data centres in Africa. Construction started in 2023 and is still ongoing.

Switch Datacenters' AMS5 facility is currently planned to be located in proximity to Vattenfall's utility plant in Diemen. Plans involve two buildings with 69.5MW IT capacity. Planning permits are still to be obtained.

H5's Seattle data center was acquired from The Seattle Times in 2011. The building sits on a 1-hectare plot, only a few blocks from the Westin Building. The facility offers connections to over 40 on-site carriers and serves as the Level 3 gateway for Seattle. H5 Seattle spreads across 3,716 square meters of space but has room to expand within the 27,220 sqm building.
In August 2022, land was acquired by Compass Datacenters towards a 48MW campus delivered in 6MW phases. The campus is currently in its first phase of construction. Launch date TBC.
COPT is building two powered shells in Virginia. The shells will be 21,088 sqm and 27,220 sqm and are set to complete in mid to late 2023.

In August 2022, it was announced that CloudHQ were planning a 180MW campus in Minneapolis on a 30 hectare site known as the "Kelzer Property - 200 Schoolmaster Drive". The site is adjacent to Stream Data Centers' 7.2MW campus. The facility particulars and building design are currently undecided.
DC Byte understands that NTT GDC has pipeline plans for additional data centre facilities in Cyberjaya.

This campus is formed under Lendlease Data Centre Partners (LLDCP), which is a joint venture funded 20% by Lendlease and 80% by Singapore sovereign wealth fund GIC. The first building entered service in April 2025.
Founded in 2001, Optic Fusion provides colocation and network connectivity services.

The Quincy data center is a 16,700 sqm building with 14MW of gross power.     It was built by Dell in 2012 to cater for its cloud and IT services. It has been leased back to NTT on a long-term basis.

KORAMCO Asset Management has a project in Ansan to construct a 9-storey data centre spanning 36,800sqm of total floor area. DCI will be partnering with KORAMCO for operations.     The data centre aims to enter service in 2026.

Located in the North Dallas high technology corridor, DFW25 is a single-story data center facility situated on the southwest corner of the 69 acre Digital Dallas data campus. Digital Realty's data center is strategically located in Digital Dallas, the 69 acre data center campus in North Dallas' high tech corridor. GDS acquired a brownfield redevelopment site for HK4 in Q4 2021. It is currently held for future development. The 22MW facility has a Net Floor Area of 7,217sqm and will be ready for service in 2028.
Tele Asia's data centre is located in Poly Centre in Fanling, Hong Kong.

This build-to-suit opportunity in Cambridge, Ontario is expected to deliver its powered shell in Q1 2027. This shell can offer 15 MW in its first phase with a pathway for expansion. The facility will also include a 112MW substation in 2028, following full build and lease of the shell.
This project was announced in July 2020. It is to be built in the Huizhou Data Industry Park in Baihua Town. The entire project is to host a total of 35,000 racks.

In December 2023, NTT announced a 50-50 JV with TEPCO, which will involve setting up a Special Purpose Company (SPC) to develop a data centre in Shiroi, Chiba. Construction is scheduled to begin in April 2025 for completion in Q2 2027.

According to a deed on record for this facility, CoreSite acquired the land at 215 County Avenue in Secaucus, New Jersey in late 2023. CoreSite has yet to announce its plans for the site, but the building currently on the land has 132,447 square feet (12,304 sqm).

Empyrion Digital is building TH1, an edge colocation data center in Bangkok's Bang Na district with a capacity of at least 12MW and spanning 9,960 sqm. The facility will be designed to target hyperscalers and support AI applications.

Ascent STL1 Data Center is a planned multi-tenant facility featuring build-to-suit options. The facility was originally announced to be US$85m, with 10+ MVA  on a 15 acre plot of land. EC72 has a designed IT power of 500kW. Edge Centres is conducting site surveys for this development and the exact location is undisclosed.
BridgeDC has expanded with a new site, MY06 Expansion, located within Sedenak Tech Park. Located on a plot across from the existing MY06 campus, the two do not share a direct access point.

The HH2/R1 data centre is located in Hamburg. The former IPHH facility has operated since 2009. Arcus Infrastructure Partners acquired in Q4 2023 regional ISP operator Internet Port Hamburg and launched Portus Data Centers as a new European data centre platform.
CtrlS have purchased additional land in the Electronic Zone. Mumbai 9 is currently in the Early stages. The site is expected to serve up to 35MW of IT Load.

ServeCentric have since extended their lease in Digital Realty's DUB10 Facility. Ascenty's data centre named Sumaré 5 located in Sumaré, Sao Paulo is going to be open in 2023. In December 2018, a joint venture between Digital Realty Trust and Brookfield Infrastructure acquired Ascenty.

The HT Data Centre is a retail colocation data centre located in Zagreb, Croatia. It is owned by Hrvatski Telekom, one of Croatia's telecommunication providers. The facility opened in 2014. Vantage Westlake is a two building project in South Fulton, Georgia. It will be located west of Plummer Road, east of the Quaker facility, and north of Riverside Drive. The project is expected to be completed in 2028.

Intergate Columbia was first opened in December 2008. Phase I included two buildings - A and B. Phase II began with the construction of Building D which was completed in 2019. The site has room to expand and could reach a total of 8 buildings.

icolo.io is part of Digital Realty is building its second data centre for Nairobi under the name NB2.

Digital Realty's Digital Sterling campus is currently under construction on 8.9 hectares of land in Sterling, Virginia. The plot received rezoning approval for industrial use in 2020.

NT1 is one of Princeton Digital Group's largest campuses. The Nantong campus will provide up to 64MW of IT Load.

In Q1 2023, DigitalEdge acquired a site in Thane from Mukand for $97.2m. They have partnered with National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIFF) and AGP DC InvestCo to develop in India. Located in the Grand Maritime Port of Marseille along the north-central coastline of the city, the facility is planned to be operational from 2026 onwards and is set to be the company's largest data centre facility in Marseille.

INAP built out its third data hall in 2021 and plans to build an identical fourth data hall.

Fiberhub's LAS1 Data Center opened in May 2010.
Land plots were purchased in the Auckland CBD area for the facility in December 2022. This will be NEXTDC's first facility in New Zealand.

HostDime's second Orlando site, in the town of Eatonville, is currently nearing the completion of its construction and set to open in 2025. The Zenlayer WNZ1 data center in Wenzhou, China.

InfraDMS' Baltimore data center is located in the office building at 1 South Street in Baltimore, Maryland.
In early 2024, JK Land Holdings acquired 108 acres (43.7 hectares) of land in Ashburn, Virginia for data center use.
LEW's second data centre is set to go live in Q2 2025, providing colocation services for clients.

In Q3 2024, it was announced that Pure had purchased a 17,650sqm plot of land in the Meco area of the Comunidad de Madrid. Nxtra Data centres will be a building a 40MW data center.     The site is expected to start construction soon.

CyrusOne acquired this 575 square meter facility in 2009. It's located on the 4th floor of a 6 story, multi-tenant building, and offers 1 MW of critical load, as well as disaster recovery and business continuity services.

CloudHQ initially announced plans for its first data centre campus in the UK in 2018. The campus will spread across two buildings initially, LHR1 and LHR2.

Across 3.2 ha plot, Equinix data centre located in Rio de Janeiro is prospected to open in Q1 2025. It is going to be the third Equinix data centre. It was named RJ3.

This campus will be connected to the dark fiber route currently under construction between Atlanta and the Myrtle Beach facility.

DC Byte understands that there are pipeline plans for JH2 facility.
GreenSquareDC are planning their WAi1 facility in Perth with a target IT capacity of 120MW.

RS-1 will be Beenet's first data centre facility in the region. The data centre will be located in the Senjak district close to central Belgrade. The facility will spread over 5000 sqm, with 150 sqm being whitespace offering 150 kW total power. Launch date TBC.

The application faced rejection in May 2023, primarily due to concerns regarding energy use and environmental impact. Luxconnect's DC 1.1 has a gross building area of 10,000 sqm and a data hall size of 3,100 sqm. TNW Networks Data Centers is a subsidiary of Teliphone Navigata-Westel Communications, founded originally as BC Rail Telecom in 1957, and provides network and colocation services from its seven facilities across Canada.  The facility size is 900 sqm.

Cyxtera's SFO3 campus in Sunnyvale, California, consists of two data centers. Constructed between 2000 and 2002, these buildings offer a total of 4,552 sqm of data hall floor and have a record of 100% uptime since their opening. The facilities were initially built by CenturyLink and acquired by Cyxtera in 2017, before the building was then acquired by Mapletree Industrial in Q2 2021. However, Cyxtera still operates the facility.

Kolkata is one of the original four metros of India and the largest commercial city in the eastern part of the country. Being a historical city, Kolkata is home to numerous palaces, monuments and temples bearing architectural significance, including India's oldest port. With around 20,000 sqft of area, STT Kolkata DC1 is the only enterprise-grade data centre in the city, catering to wide range of business enterprises. The data centre is both scalable, resilient to demand, which resources can be adjusted as per requirements.
